test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact information).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows manual selection of RBC contact information outside Start of Mission for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the first session is still in the 'Establishing' state. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session establishment process continues or fails according to standard protocols, but no second parallel session attempt is initiated.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC after establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., order from trackside).

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or the new session is with a different RBC requiring termination of the old one per standard transition logic).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (e.g., RBC transition order).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to handle session transitions where the current supervising RBC session is terminated to establish a new one.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC session does not terminate current session if multi-session capable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established and active. The OBU is capable of handling more than one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU hardware/software configuration supports multiple concurrent GSM-R sessions.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC session terminates current session if single-session only
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established and active. The OBU is configured to handle only one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU hardware/software configuration is limited to a single concurrent GSM-R session.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Sleeping mode (Nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing: 1) Information valid for both directions, 2) Information valid only for Nominal direction, 3) Information valid only for Reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for both directions.

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of the information valid only for the Nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid only for the Nominal direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of the information valid only for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Reverse direction.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Shunting mode (Reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing: 1) Information valid for both directions, 2) Information valid only for Nominal direction, 3) Information valid only for Reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for both directions.

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of the information valid only for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid only for the Reverse direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of the information valid only for the Nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Nominal direction.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on new parameter receipt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=10s. The last MA request was sent 12 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where MA requests are applicable (e.g., waiting for MA).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC (Period=5s).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately, because the time since the last MA request (12s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and no immediate request if time is less than new period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=10s. The last MA request was sent 2 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where MA requests are applicable.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC (Period=5s).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request immediately, because the time since the last MA request (2s) is lower than the newly received repetition period (5s). The next request will be scheduled according to the new period.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching the end of the overlap, which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data indicating approach to the end of the overlap.

steps.action: Move the train towards the end of the overlap while the LoA is being supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the end of the overlap as a Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for any active SvL.
steps.expected: No SvL (end of overlap, Danger Point, or end of End Section) is active on board.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid until new restriction or Level 2 MA acceptance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) is active and valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1) No new speed restriction received. 2) Switch to Level 2 mode. 3) Accept a Level 2 MA.

steps.action: Operate in Level 1 mode without receiving a new speed restriction.
steps.expected: The Level 1 speed restriction (80 km/h) remains valid.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction remains valid.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 logic/MA).

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction replaced by new restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) is active and valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 60 km/h) received via balise.

steps.action: Receive a new Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (60 km/h) from a balise.
steps.expected: The new speed restriction (60 km/h) replaces the old one (80 km/h) immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific train performance profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maximum Train Speed value set to 200 km/h.

steps.action: Define the maximum train speed as 200 km/h in the OBU configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the value.

steps.action: Check how the OBU handles this value in its speed restriction logic.
steps.expected: The OBU handles the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state: No permitted braking distance limit before trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a mode where speed supervision is active (e.g., Full Supervision). No speed restriction data has been received from trackside yet.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows monitoring of the internal 'permitted braking distance' limit value or the resulting speed limit calculation.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed restriction status and the permitted braking distance limit value.
steps.expected: The OBU reports 'no speed restriction' as the initial state. The permitted braking distance limit does not constrain the train speed (i.e., the limit is effectively infinite or not applied).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) is currently active and constraining the train speed based on trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside message ordering the resumption of the initial state (e.g., via a specific MA or balise data indicating end of restriction).
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment can simulate a trackside order to reset speed restrictions to the initial state.

steps.action: Verify that the current speed restriction is active and constraining the train speed.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) and the permitted braking distance limit is active.

steps.action: Simulate the trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the order and clears the active speed restriction.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed restriction status and the permitted braking distance limit value after the order.
steps.expected: The OBU returns to the 'no speed restriction' initial state. The permitted braking distance limit no longer constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers reconnection attempt on same system
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and has an established safe radio connection with Radio System A. EURORADIO is functional.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: Radio System A is available and capable of accepting new connections.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection between OBU and Radio System A.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active safe radio connection with Radio System A.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with Radio System A.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has lost the safe radio connection during an established communication session. The session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio environment where the first N attempts fail and the (N+1)th attempt succeeds.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session remains active and the train is before the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first reconnection attempt to fail.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the second reconnection attempt to succeed.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established and the OBU stops repeating the setup attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has lost the safe radio connection during an established communication session. The train has not passed the RIU termination location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated session termination signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination is valid and recognized by the OBU.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Trigger the termination of the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has lost the safe radio connection during an established communication session. An RIU order specifying a termination location is active. The session is not otherwise terminated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data simulating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order is correctly loaded and the location is defined.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location given in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] OBU initiates termination upon explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: The trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to the OBU. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or defined condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC). No termination conditions defined in SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside termination order is sent. No internal termination condition is triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration sufficient to observe potential spontaneous termination, ensuring no trackside order or internal condition occurs.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the communication session and does not initiate termination.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination when internal condition is fulfilled without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. A termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 (e.g., loss of trackside link integrity or specific safety state) is triggered internally.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger the internal termination condition defined in SUBSET-026.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is identifiable and triggerable in the test environment.

steps.action: Trigger the internal termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 without sending a trackside termination order.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats Termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of a communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message. The trackside does not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside remains silent (no acknowledgement) for the fixed waiting time defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time value from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1 is known and configured in the test environment.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time expires without receiving an acknowledgement from the trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time again after the repetition.
steps.expected: The OBU is in a waiting state for the next potential repetition if no acknowledgement is received.

test_cases.title: OBU stops repeating Termination message upon receiving acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message and is waiting for an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an acknowledgement within the fixed waiting time.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time.

steps.action: The trackside sends an acknowledgement before the fixed waiting time expires.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the repetition process and does not send further 'Termination of Communication Session' messages.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and is repeating the 'Termination of Communication Session' message. The trackside is configured to not send any acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside does not send acknowledgement for the defined number of repetitions.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions and fixed waiting time are known from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message for the defined number of times, waiting the fixed time after each repetition.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the message the defined number of times. No acknowledgement is received.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time after the last sending elapses without an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: OBU does not consider session terminated before maximum repetitions are exhausted
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and is repeating the 'Termination of Communication Session' message. The trackside is configured to not send any acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside does not send acknowledgement for fewer than the defined number of repetitions.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is greater than 1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message one fewer time than the defined number of repetitions, waiting the fixed time after each.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to wait for an acknowledgement and does not consider the session terminated.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU kapalı durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve çalışır durumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R ağının mevcut olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU güç açma komutu verilir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Sürücünün yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girmesi üzerine kayıt talebi

test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği (PLMN ID).

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzünden yeni bir GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni girilen kimliğe sahip GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı komutu üzerine GSM-R kayıt talebi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır ve GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen kayıt komutu mesajı.

steps.action: Ray kenarından OBU'ya GSM-R kayıt komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal için GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi yokken varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU hafızasında Radyo Ağı tipi bulunmamaktadır (ilk güç açma veya sistem hatası sonrası).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU üzerinde varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU güç açılır ve radyo ağı tipi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, yapılandırılmış varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı olmayan radyo sistemi için güvenli bağlantı talebinin yapılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Depolanan Radyo Ağı tipi, takılı radyo sistemleri ve sürücünün tek radyo seçimi göz önüne alındığında, gerekli radyo sisteminin Radyo Ağına kayıtlı olmadığı bir senaryo hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC ile oturum kurma komutu (ray kenarından).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.5.6.7'de belirtilen koşullar sağlanmaktadır.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RBC ile oturum kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobil Terminal kayıtlı değilken RIU oturum talebinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ancak GSM-R Radyo Ağına kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobil Terminal kayıtlıyken RIU oturum talebinin yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve GSM-R Radyo Ağına düzgünce kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Ray kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma talebinde bulunur.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Display of 'No Connection' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where no safe radio connection is established with any RBC/RIU.
test_cases.assumptions: The driver interface is active and capable of displaying status indicators.

steps.action: Observe the safe radio connection status indicator on the driver interface. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Display of 'Connection Up' status
test_cases.preconditions: A safe radio connection is successfully established with the relevant RBC/RIU.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC/RIU is available and the connection setup procedure has completed successfully.

steps.action: Observe the safe radio connection status indicator on the driver interface.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Display of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has attempted to set up a safe radio connection but failed, or an existing connection has been lost.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure or loss condition has been detected by the OBU.

steps.action: Observe the safe radio connection status indicator on the driver interface.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Timer start on session establishment request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it initiates a session establishment request (triggers b) to e) of SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4) to the relevant RBC/RIU.
test_cases.assumptions: The connection status timer is accessible for monitoring or its start can be inferred from subsequent behavior.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to send the first request to set up a safe radio connection for session establishment.
steps.expected: The connection status timer starts.

test_cases.title: Timer start on session maintenance request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it initiates a request to maintain an existing session (§3.5.4.2, §3.5.4.4) to the relevant RBC/RIU.
test_cases.assumptions: The connection status timer is accessible for monitoring or its start can be inferred from subsequent behavior.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to send the first request to maintain the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The connection status timer starts.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'No Connection'. The conditions for transition to 'Connection Up' as defined in SUBSET-026 Table 2 are met (e.g., successful connection setup).
test_cases.assumptions: The transition conditions of SUBSET-026 Table 2 are satisfied.

steps.action: Satisfy the transition conditions for moving from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Up'.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Up'. The conditions for transition to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' as defined in SUBSET-026 Table 2 are met (e.g., loss of radio link).
test_cases.assumptions: The transition conditions of SUBSET-026 Table 2 are satisfied.

steps.action: Satisfy the transition conditions for moving from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'. The conditions for transition to 'No Connection' as defined in SUBSET-026 Table 2 are met (e.g., timeout or reset).
test_cases.assumptions: The transition conditions of SUBSET-026 Table 2 are satisfied.

steps.action: Satisfy the transition conditions for moving from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection'.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Invalid transition prevention
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'No Connection'.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to allow monitoring of state changes.

steps.action: Attempt to force a direct transition from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' without satisfying the intermediate 'Connection Up' state or valid transition path defined in SUBSET-026 Table 1.
steps.expected: The indication status remains 'No Connection' or follows only valid transitions; it does not jump directly to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' if that transition is not permitted from 'No Connection' in Table 1.

test_cases.title: Display of RIU connection status for current infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has an active safe radio connection with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU) for the current infill area.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is correctly configured with the infill area data and the driver interface is active.

steps.action: Observe the safe radio connection status indicator on the driver interface while the train is within the current infill area.
steps.expected: The indicator displays the status 'Connection Up' corresponding to the RIU of the current infill area.

test_cases.title: Display of RIU connection status when connection is lost
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has an active safe radio connection with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU) for the current infill area.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio link to the RIU can be interrupted for testing purposes.

steps.action: Interrupt the radio connection with the RIU of the current infill area.
steps.expected: The indicator changes to display the status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' for the RIU of the current infill area.

test_cases.title: ETC-023: Geçersiz konum iken ORBG geçişinde geçerli konumun alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir konum değeri bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG geçiş sinyali.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün belirlenmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Aktif kabin bilgisi: Kabin A.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: Konum tabanlı denetimde ön uç konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir tahmini tren ön uç konumuna sahiptir. SUBSET-026'da özel referans (maksimum güvenli ön uç veya minimum güvenli arka uç) belirtilmemiş bir konum tabanlı fonksiyon aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tahmini tren ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Konum tabanlı fonksiyonun tetiklenme eşiği: 1000 m.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'da belirtilen istisna durumlar (End Section timer, Overlap timer, level transition, RBC/RBC border) bu test senaryosunda geçerli değildir.

steps.action: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu, konum tabanlı fonksiyonun tetiklenme eşiğine eşit olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, konum tabanlı fonksiyonu tetiklerken referans nokta olarak tahmini tren ön uç konumunu (1000 m) kullanır.

steps.action: OBU'nun konum referansı seçimi logları veya durum göstergeleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Loglarda veya göstergelerde, fonksiyonun 'estimated front end position' (tahmini ön uç konumu) referansını kullandığı doğrulanır.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: SUBSET-026 istisnası durumunda özel referansın kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir tahmini tren ön uç konumuna ve maksimum güvenli ön uç (max safe front end) konumuna sahiptir. End Section timer başlangıç konumu denetimi aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tahmini tren ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Maksimum güvenli ön uç konumu: 1050 m. End Section timer başlangıç konumu: 1050 m.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre End Section timer başlangıç konumu için referans 'max safe front end' olarak belirlenmiştir.

steps.action: Trenin konumu, tahmini ön uç konumunun (1000 m) End Section timer başlangıç konumunun (1050 m) altında, ancak maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunun (1050 m) eşit olduğu bir duruma getirilir.
steps.expected: OBU, End Section timer denetimi için referans olarak tahmini ön uç konumunu değil, maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunu (1050 m) kullanır.

steps.action: End Section timer denetiminin sonucu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Denetim, maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunun (1050 m) başlangıç konumunu (1050 m) geçtiği için tetiklenir veya ilgili durum güncellenir. Tahmini ön uç konumu (1000 m) bu denetimde referans olarak kullanılmadığı için, 1000 m < 1050 m olmasına rağmen denetim durumu, 1050 m referansına göre belirlenir.

test_cases.title: Report train position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (e.g., LRBG-100) has been passed. The OBU has reported its position to the RBC.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-100 and allow OBU to report position to RBC.
steps.expected: OBU reports train position to RBC referring to LRBG-100.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-101.
steps.expected: OBU updates the reference LRBG to LRBG-101 for subsequent position reports.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside information referring to recently reported LRBG

steps.action: Receive trackside information from RBC referring to LRBG-100.
steps.expected: OBU accepts the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside information referring to LRBG outside recent window

test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends trackside information referring to LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is 3. LRBGs 103, 104, 105 are the recent ones. LRBG-100 is outside this window.

steps.action: Receive trackside information from RBC referring to LRBG-100.
steps.expected: OBU rejects the trackside information or raises an error, as LRBG-100 is not among the recently reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Compliance check with linking consistency enabled

test_cases.title: Compliance check with linking consistency disabled

steps.action: Pass LRBG-300.
steps.expected: OBU considers LRBG-300 compliant and reports train position to RBC referring to LRBG-300.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] OBU ignores information invalid for train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transmit a message containing data valid for 'Reverse' orientation via the selected transmission medium.
test_cases.assumptions: The transmission medium allows injection of specific orientation-tagged data for testing purposes.

steps.action: Inject a data packet tagged as valid for 'Reverse' orientation while the train orientation is 'Forward'. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the data packet; no state change or application of the data occurs.

steps.action: Inject a data packet tagged as valid for 'Forward' orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the data packet.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where train orientation cannot be related to the trackside device direction (e.g., unknown balise group crossing direction).
test_cases.test_inputs: Data valid for 'Forward' only; Data valid for 'Reverse' only; Data valid for 'Both' directions.
test_cases.assumptions: A test scenario exists to simulate the condition where orientation is unknown relative to the trackside device.

steps.action: Inject data valid for 'Forward' direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Inject data valid for 'Reverse' direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Inject data valid for 'Both' directions.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data value V0. Current position is at the start of the new data segment.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [V1, V2, V3] with distances [D1, D2, D3].
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows precise control over the sequence of profile values and their associated incremental distances.

steps.action: Receive value V1 with incremental distance D1.
steps.expected: V1 applies over the distance D1. The previously received data V0 applies over the first distance (before V1 starts).

steps.action: Receive value V2 with incremental distance D2.
steps.expected: V2 applies over the distance D2, starting immediately after the end of V1's distance.

steps.action: Receive value V3 with incremental distance D3.
steps.expected: V3 applies over the distance D3, starting immediately after the end of V2's distance.

test_cases.title: Last value in continuous profile applies without limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving a continuous profile data stream.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [V1, V2] where V2 is the last value in the current profile block.
test_cases.assumptions: The profile block is defined such that V2 is the final element and is not an end-of-profile value.

steps.action: Receive V1 with distance D1.
steps.expected: V1 applies over distance D1.

steps.action: Receive V2 as the last value in the sequence.
steps.expected: V2 applies without limit (indefinitely) until a new profile is received or an end-of-profile value is encountered.

test_cases.title: Value followed by zero distance is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Value V1 with distance 0, followed by Value V2 with distance D2.
test_cases.assumptions: Zero distance is a valid input for the incremental distance field.

steps.action: Receive value V1 with an incremental distance of 0.
steps.expected: V1 is taken into account (applied at the current position) despite the zero distance.

steps.action: Receive value V2 with incremental distance D2.
steps.expected: V2 applies over distance D2, starting from the position where V1 was applied.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of location data with unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data L0. Current position is at the start of the new data segment.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data values [L1, L2] with unsigned incremental distances [D1, D2].
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows injection of location data with specific unsigned incremental distances.

steps.action: Receive location data L1 with unsigned incremental distance D1.
steps.expected: L1 applies over the distance D1. The previously received data L0 remains in use over the first distance (before L1 starts).

steps.action: Receive location data L2 with unsigned incremental distance D2.
steps.expected: L2 applies over the distance D2, starting immediately after the end of L1's distance.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data or is using initial/default values.
test_cases.test_inputs: Element 1: Value V1, Length L1, Start Distance D1 (from previous). Element 2: Value V2, Length L2, Start Distance D2 (from Element 1 start).
test_cases.assumptions: D2 is chosen such that Element 2 overlaps with Element 1 (i.e., D2 < L1).

steps.action: Receive Element 1 (V1, L1) with start distance D1 from the previous element's start.
steps.expected: V1 applies for length L1 starting at distance D1. The previously received data applies over the first distance (before D1).

steps.action: Receive Element 2 (V2, L2) with start distance D2 from the start of Element 1.
steps.expected: V2 applies for length L2 starting at distance D2 from Element 1's start. The OBU accepts the overlap between Element 1 and Element 2.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of linking information with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A sequence of linking information data is available for injection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking data sequence: [Value_A, Value_B, Value_C] with distances [100, 200, 300].
test_cases.assumptions: The transmission medium allows injection of specific linking information structures for testing purposes.

steps.action: Inject linking information where the first distance is 100 and the first value is Value_A.
steps.expected: The OBU associates Value_A with the balise group located at distance 100 from the current reference point.

steps.action: Inject the next part of the linking information where the distance is 200 and the value is Value_B.
steps.expected: The OBU associates Value_B with the balise group located at distance 100 + 200 = 300 from the current reference point.

steps.action: Inject the final part of the linking information where the distance is 300 and the value is Value_C.
steps.expected: The OBU associates Value_C with the balise group located at distance 300 + 300 = 600 from the current reference point.

test_cases.title: SOLR değişiminde konum öğelerinin yeniden konumlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Balise Grubu A'yı SOLR olarak belirlemiştir. Balise Grubu B, Balise Grubu A'dan 100 metre ileridedir ve bağlantı bilgisiyle bu mesafe bilinmektedir. Balise Grubu A'ya referanslı bir konum bilgisi (örn. tahmini tren ucu pozisyonu) mevcuttur.

test_cases.title: SOLR dışı balise grubuna referanslı bilginin değerlendirilmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Integrity loss condition triggered (e.g., brake pipe pressure drop or sensor fault).

steps.action: Trigger a train integrity loss condition (e.g., simulate brake pipe pressure drop).
steps.expected: OBU changes the train integrity status to 'Integrity lost'.

steps.action: Observe the train integrity status reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The reported status is 'Integrity lost' and no train length is reported.

test_cases.title: Transition from Confirmed by External Source to Integrity Lost
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Current train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Integrity loss condition triggered.

steps.action: Trigger a train integrity loss condition.
steps.expected: OBU changes the train integrity status to 'Integrity lost'.

steps.action: Observe the train integrity status reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The reported status is 'Integrity lost' and no train length is reported.

test_cases.title: Transition from Integrity Lost to Confirmed by Driver
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Current train integrity status is 'Integrity lost'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver confirms train integrity via HMI after loss.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity through the driver interface after the loss event.
steps.expected: OBU changes the train integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Observe the train integrity status reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The reported status is 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length is included.

test_cases.title: Transition from Integrity Lost to Confirmed by External Source
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Current train integrity status is 'Integrity lost'.
test_cases.test_inputs: External integrity confirmation signal received after loss.

steps.action: Provide a valid external train integrity confirmation signal after the loss event.
steps.expected: OBU changes the train integrity status to 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Observe the train integrity status reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The reported status is 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length is included.

test_cases.title: Invalid Transition Attempt: No Integrity Information to Integrity Lost
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Current train integrity status is 'No train integrity information'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Integrity loss condition triggered while status is 'No information'.
test_cases.assumptions: According to SUBSET-026 Table 2b, direct transition from 'No information' to 'Lost' is not permitted without prior confirmation.

steps.action: Trigger an integrity loss condition while the status is 'No train integrity information'.
steps.expected: OBU does not change the status to 'Integrity lost' directly. The status remains 'No train integrity information' or follows a valid intermediate transition if defined.

steps.action: Observe the train integrity status reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The reported status is not 'Integrity lost' unless a valid transition path was followed.

test_cases.title: Driver requests display of estimated front end position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and connected to the train. The driver interface is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command: 'Show Position'

steps.action: Driver issues the request to display the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position relative to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Driver requests to stop display of estimated front end position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently displaying the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command: 'Hide Position'

steps.action: Driver issues the request to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Position display is not shown without driver request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and connected to the train. The driver interface is active. No position display is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: None

steps.action: Wait for a period of time without issuing any driver request for position display.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled since reference
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has a known geographical reference location (e.g., Track Km 10.000). The train has moved a known distance (e.g., 500 meters) from this reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command: 'Show Position'
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly tracks the distance travelled since the last geographical reference location.

steps.action: Driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed position is the reference location plus the distance travelled (e.g., Track Km 10.500).

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with zero distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has a known geographical reference location (e.g., Track Km 20.000). The train is stationary at this reference location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command: 'Show Position'

steps.action: Driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed position is equal to the reference location (e.g., Track Km 20.000).

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Supervision start calculates remaining distances for all SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where supervision can be started (e.g., after power-up or reset). Train is stationary at a known location not aligned with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 distance values (roll-away, reverse, standstill, Post Trip reversing, trip suppression, Staff Responsible max) are configured in the OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to observe the calculated remaining distance values for each supervision type.

steps.action: Start the OBU supervision function. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU begins the supervision process.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the roll-away protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured roll-away distance value.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the standstill protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured standstill distance value.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the reverse movement protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured reverse movement distance value.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the Post Trip reversing distance.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured Post Trip reversing distance value.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the trip suppression distance after Override.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured trip suppression distance value.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured Staff Responsible maximum distance value.

test_cases.title: Supervision restart calculates remaining distances independently of train position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU supervision is active. Train has moved a significant distance from the initial start point. Supervision is stopped and then restarted.
test_cases.test_inputs: SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 distance values are configured.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows stopping and restarting supervision for testing purposes.

steps.action: Stop the OBU supervision function.
steps.expected: Supervision is halted.

steps.action: Restart the OBU supervision function.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the supervision process again.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the roll-away protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured roll-away distance value, independent of the current train position relative to balise groups.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the calculated remaining distance for the standstill protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance equal to the configured standstill distance value.

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for roll-away
test_cases.preconditions: OBU supervision is active. Roll-away protection is enabled. Train is at the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Roll-away distance is set to 100m. Train moves forward 50m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU estimates distance travelled using odometry or similar method. The estimated distance is accurate for the test.

steps.action: Start supervision at location L0.
steps.expected: Supervision is active. Remaining distance for roll-away is 100m.

steps.action: Move the train forward 50m from L0.
steps.expected: The OBU estimates the distance travelled as 50m.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining distance for roll-away protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance as 50m (100m - 50m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU supervision is active. Standstill protection is enabled. Train is at the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standstill distance is set to 50m. Train moves forward 20m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU estimates distance travelled using odometry or similar method.

steps.action: Start supervision at location L0.
steps.expected: Supervision is active. Remaining distance for standstill is 50m.

steps.action: Move the train forward 20m from L0.
steps.expected: The OBU estimates the distance travelled as 20m.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining distance for standstill protection.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance as 30m (50m - 20m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for reversing in Post Trip
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Post Trip state. Reversing protection is enabled. Train is at the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Post Trip reversing distance is set to 30m. Train moves backward 10m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU estimates distance travelled in the reverse direction.

steps.action: Start supervision for reversing in Post Trip at location L0.
steps.expected: Supervision is active. Remaining distance for reversing is 30m.

steps.action: Move the train backward 10m from L0.
steps.expected: The OBU estimates the distance travelled in the reverse direction as 10m.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining distance for reversing in Post Trip.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance as 20m (30m - 10m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for trip suppression after Override
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where trip suppression after Override is applicable. Train is at the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trip suppression distance is set to 200m. Train moves forward 100m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU estimates distance travelled using odometry or similar method.

steps.action: Start supervision for trip suppression after Override at location L0.
steps.expected: Supervision is active. Remaining distance for trip suppression is 200m.

steps.action: Move the train forward 100m from L0.
steps.expected: The OBU estimates the distance travelled as 100m.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining distance for trip suppression after Override.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the remaining distance as 100m (200m - 100m).

test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Override mode. The train has lost valid position (e.g., after passing a balise group without reading it or due to GPS loss). The former EOA/LOA is known. The distance to be supervised is 0 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer reading, estimated/max/min safe front end positions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of 'no valid position' state and provides a diagnostic interface to observe the calculated remaining distance and the virtual train front position.

steps.action: Initiate the supervision for the zero distance to the former EOA/LOA after Override.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervising a virtual train front position.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 10 m) using the odometer.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as the supervised distance (0 m) minus the distance travelled, corrected by odometer under/over-reading. The virtual front position is updated accordingly.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current remaining distance to the former EOA/LOA.
steps.expected: The reported remaining distance reflects the movement away from the start point, adjusted for odometer errors as defined in §3.6.7.3.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance using virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The Staff Responsible maximum distance is configured (e.g., 500 m). The train is at a known location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer reading, estimated/max/min safe front end positions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the calculated remaining distance and the virtual train front position.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU begins supervising the Staff Responsible distance using a virtual train front position.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 100 m).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the virtual train front position based on the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining Staff Responsible distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as the configured Staff Responsible distance minus the distance travelled, corrected by odometer under/over-reading as defined in §3.6.7.3.

test_cases.title: Odometer under-reading correction in virtual front position calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a distance (e.g., Staff Responsible) using a virtual train front position. The odometer is configured to simulate an under-reading (e.g., reports 90% of actual distance).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated odometer under-reading factor, actual distance travelled.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows configuration of odometer error simulation and provides a diagnostic interface to observe the corrected remaining distance.

steps.action: Start the supervision for a known distance (e.g., 100 m).
steps.expected: The OBU initializes the virtual train front position.

steps.action: Move the train by an actual distance of 50 m, but the odometer reports 45 m (10% under-reading).
steps.expected: The OBU applies the correction for odometer under-reading as defined in §3.6.7.3.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated using the corrected distance travelled, not the raw odometer reading, ensuring the supervision reflects the true position within the allowed error bounds.

test_cases.title: MA ile birlikte gelen SSP/gradient verilerinin yetersiz olması durumunda MA kabul edilmemesi

steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profillerini kabul etmez.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kabul durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: MA reddedilir ve ilgili hata durumu veya uyarı üretilir.

test_cases.title: MA uzunluğunu karşılayan SSP/gradient ile MA kabul edilmesi (Negatif Kontrol)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, MA işleme modundadır. Araçtaki mevcut SSP ve gradient verileri, gelen MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamaktadır.

test_cases.assumptions: MA'nın tam uzunluğu SUBSET-026 §3.7.2.3.1–3.7.2.3.2'ye göre hesaplanmıştır ve SSP/gradient verileri bu uzunluğu tam olarak kapsamaktadır.

steps.action: Araçtaki mevcut SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsadığı bir MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profillerini kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kabul durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilir ve normal işleme devam eder.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Replacement of stored track description upon receipt of new information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and has stored track description information for a specific track section.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description message containing updated data for the same track section.
test_cases.assumptions: The new track description is valid and conforms to SUBSET-026 format.

steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored track description of the affected section.
steps.expected: The stored information is replaced with the new data, reflecting the update completely or from the start location as per SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Replacement of stored linking information upon receipt of new information

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored linking information.
steps.expected: The stored information is replaced from the reference balise group of the new information, following SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Application of replacement rules for Supervised Manoeuvre with matching orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Supervised mode. The current train orientation is North. Stored location-based information exists for the track ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction North.
test_cases.assumptions: The authorisation contains valid location-based information that triggers replacement rules.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction matching the current train orientation (North).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the authorisation.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored location-based information in the affected area.
steps.expected: The stored information is updated according to the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Deletion of stored information for Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Supervised mode. The current train orientation is North. Stored location-based information exists for the track ahead.

test_cases.assumptions: The authorisation contains valid location-based information.

steps.expected: The OBU accepts the authorisation.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the previously stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The previously stored location-based information is deleted. The normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 are not applied.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] MA request includes all applicable reasons

test_cases.assumptions: The specific reasons are defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1. The test environment allows monitoring of the MA request message content.

steps.action: Trigger an MA request while multiple MA request reasons are applicable. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request message.
steps.expected: The MA request message contains all the applicable MA request reasons.

test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation-location criterion is defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1. The location is known and can be simulated.

steps.action: Simulate the train front approaching the location resulting from the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the train front has not yet passed the location.

steps.action: Simulate the train front passing the location resulting from the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion. The timer is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time simulation to reach the moment defined by the timer criterion.
