steps.action: Start the Section timer/LOA speed timer.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the timer has not reached the defined moment.

steps.action: Simulate the passage of time until the moment resulting from the Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (Level 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. The RBC has sent a track description containing a section that is eligible for deletion under a situation defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (excluding situations a, b, f, and k).
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message deleting a part of the track description corresponding to a valid situation in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., situation c).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen for the test is one that is not excluded (a, b, f, k) and is supported by the test environment.

steps.action: Send a track description update from the RBC that deletes a part of the track description under a valid situation (e.g., situation c).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the deletion.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's communication with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by excluded track description deletion situations
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. The RBC has sent a track description containing a section that is eligible for deletion under one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k) defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message deleting a part of the track description corresponding to an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen for the test is one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k).

steps.action: Send a track description update from the RBC that deletes a part of the track description under an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the deletion.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's communication with the RBC for a defined period.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A Movement Authority (MA) containing an End Section timer start location and a non-zero time-out value is received from trackside. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer start location at 1000m from current position, time-out 60s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's max safe front end is accurately tracked.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting down from the received time-out value.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The End Section timer is running. The MA includes location-based information (e.g., speed limits) and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (EOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer time-out value set to a short duration (e.g., 5s) for testing. Train speed is constant.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position.

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The location-based information is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the new End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific timestamp.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized with the trackside time.

steps.action: Receive the MA message in Level 2.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the timestamp of the received message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA data.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly identifies the first balise of the group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The LOA speed timer is running. The LOA has a non-zero speed associated with it.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer time-out value set to a short duration (e.g., 5s).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero.

steps.action: Check the status of the LOA.
steps.expected: The LOA becomes an EOA with the Supervised Location (SvL) defined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5.

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The location-based information is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A MA containing an Overlap timer start location and a non-zero time-out value is received. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at 500m from current position, time-out 30s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's max safe front end is accurately tracked.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting down from the received time-out value.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A MA containing an Overlap timer start location and a time-out value of 'infinite' is received. The train is moving towards the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location, time-out 'infinite'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly interprets 'infinite' as a valid time-out value that still requires the timer to be started.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started, even though the time-out value is 'infinite'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer is running. The MA includes an overlap with an associated release speed and a non-zero target speed at the EOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer time-out value set to a short duration (e.g., 5s).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The overlap and its associated release speed are deleted.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5, and information per Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: Any non-zero target speed at the EOA is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap timer has been started. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed reduced to 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU detects standstill accurately.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has started.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired.

steps.action: Check the consequences applied.
steps.expected: The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout when new MA start location is behind train
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The OBU receives a new MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location located behind the current max safe front end of the train.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly compares the start location with the max safe front end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with the Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer has exceeded its time-out value.

steps.action: Check the consequences applied.
steps.expected: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 is applied (overlap deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with active overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End Section are also defined in the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with overlap, Danger Point, and End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The overlap is valid and active.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out overlap and Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The overlap has timed out. A Danger Point is defined in the MA. An End Section is also defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with timed-out overlap, Danger Point, and End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The overlap timeout has been processed.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: No overlap exists (or it has timed out). No Danger Point is defined in the MA. An End Section is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with no valid overlap, no Danger Point, and an End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The End Section is valid.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA in Full Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA in Automatic Driving mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision mode. An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill MA is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA in Limited Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA not evaluated in other modes
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision (e.g., Standstill or Shutdown). An infill MA is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a mode where infill MA evaluation is not specified.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA in a non-specified mode.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA referencing the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that refers to the main signal balise group for which linking information is available.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA and updates the Movement Authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is NOT available in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA referencing the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that refers to the main signal balise group for which linking information is missing.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA. The current Movement Authority remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from RBC
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old) with specific data (e.g., speed profile, end of authority).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) transmitted by the RBC with different data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can log or expose the internal MA data for verification.

steps.action: Receive MA_old from the RBC and verify it is active. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU stores and supervises MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_new from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of MA_old with the data from MA_new.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data.
steps.expected: The stored MA data matches MA_new completely, and no remnants of MA_old remain.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from a main-signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) read from a main-signal balise group (non-infill information) with different data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can distinguish between RBC messages and balise group messages.

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify it is active.
steps.expected: The OBU stores and supervises MA_old data.

steps.action: Pass a main-signal balise group containing MA_new (non-infill).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of MA_old with the data from MA_new.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data.
steps.expected: The stored MA data matches MA_new completely.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data upon receiving infill information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old) with data up to a certain point. The next main signal is at location L_next.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA (MA_infill) containing data beyond L_next.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can identify the location of the next main signal and the infill nature of the message.

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify it is active.
steps.expected: The OBU stores and supervises MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_infill (infill information).
steps.expected: The OBU retains the data of MA_old up to the announced balise group at the next main signal (L_next) and replaces only the data beyond L_next with the data from MA_infill.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data before and after L_next.
steps.expected: Data before L_next matches MA_old, and data after L_next matches MA_infill.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA. The next main signal is at a specific balise group location L_ref.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA received.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can log the start position of the new MA section.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the start position of the new MA section in the OBU.
steps.expected: The new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal (L_ref).

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA defining SvL as MA shortening while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining a Supervision Limit (SvL) where the SvL is located before the current end of the LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can log the type of MA processing (shortening vs. extension) and the deletion of location-based information.

steps.action: Receive a new MA defining an SvL while the OBU is supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 corresponding to the shortened area.

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA defining SvL as MA shortening regardless of SvL position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining an SvL where the SvL is located at or beyond the current end of the LOA (boundary case).
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'wherever the SvL lies', implying even if it doesn't shorten the current LOA end, it is treated as a shortening event for data management purposes.

steps.action: Receive a new MA defining an SvL located at or beyond the current LOA end.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 as per the shortening logic.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an active MA with a defined end of authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information packet.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the MA status to verify that no shortening action is triggered.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information while the OBU is supervising the active MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the repositioning information.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA status and stored authority data.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the event as an MA shortening; the stored MA data and end of authority remain unchanged.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an active MA with a defined end of authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA packet that ends with a Limit of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the MA status to verify that no shortening action is triggered.

steps.action: Receive a new MA that ends with an LOA while the OBU is supervising the previous MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA status and stored authority data.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the event as an MA shortening; the MA is updated according to the new data without triggering shortening-specific deletion logic.

test_cases.title: Adoption of shortened MA when train is behind Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located behind the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list. Train position data indicating the front end is behind the new Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC request is valid and correctly formatted. The OBU can simulate or receive a specific train position relative to the MA limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a value where the Indication supervision limit is ahead of the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU has adopted the proposed shortened MA, the associated mode profile, and the SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to adopt the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Rejection of shortened MA when train is at or ahead of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located at or ahead of the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value where the Indication supervision limit is behind or at the current train front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC request is valid and correctly formatted. The OBU can simulate or receive a specific train position relative to the MA limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a value where the Indication supervision limit is behind the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value where the Indication supervision limit coincides exactly with the current train front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear of' for adoption. Therefore, being exactly at the limit is not 'in rear of', so it should be rejected. This test verifies the boundary interpretation.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a value where the Indication supervision limit is exactly at the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request, as the train is not in rear of the limit.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, desteklenen infill ortamları listesine sahip olarak yapılandırılmıştır. OBU, geçerli bir balis grubundan önceki seyrine ait güncel bilgiyi almıştır.

test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun desteklemediği bir infill ortamı (örneğin, OBU'da bulunmayan bir radyo frekansı veya protokol) test senaryosunda tanımlanmıştır.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit further infill information from the loop antenna.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the received infill information (no state change or processing log entry for the infill).

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.

test_cases.title: No recomputation when non-input parameters change

steps.action: Record the current computed speed restriction value.
steps.expected: A baseline speed restriction value is recorded.

steps.action: Change a parameter that is not an input to the permitted braking distance computation (e.g., update a non-relevant status message).
steps.expected: The OBU does not recompute the speed restriction.

steps.action: Verify the speed restriction value after the parameter change.
steps.expected: The speed restriction value remains unchanged from the baseline.

test_cases.title: Recomputation triggered by change in input parameter

steps.action: Record the current computed speed restriction value.
steps.expected: A baseline speed restriction value is recorded.

steps.action: Change one of the input parameters used for the computation (e.g., update the gradient value).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the change in the input.

steps.action: Verify the speed restriction value after the input change.
steps.expected: The OBU recomputes the speed restriction, and the new value differs from the baseline (assuming the change affects the result).

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions: EBD curve and zero speed at PBD
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it computes speed restriction. Test environment allows inspection of the braking curve logic or simulation of the braking process.

steps.expected: The OBU computes the speed restriction.

steps.action: Simulate or inspect the braking curve generated by the OBU for this speed restriction.
steps.expected: The braking curve is an EBD (Emergency Brake Deceleration) curve.

steps.action: Verify the endpoint of the braking curve.
steps.expected: The braking curve reaches zero speed exactly at the permitted braking distance.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions: Gradient and Deceleration parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is computing speed restriction. Test environment allows verification of the internal parameters used in the calculation.

steps.expected: The OBU accepts the gradient data.

steps.action: Inspect the calculation process or results to verify the gradient used.
steps.expected: The calculation uses a rotating-mass-compensated gradient.

steps.action: Inspect the deceleration values used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The decelerations ignore trackside adhesion profiles and use safe-only values.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions: Fixed assumptions for delays and inaccuracies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is computing speed restriction. Test environment allows verification of the fixed assumption values used in the calculation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standard input data for speed restriction computation.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed assumption values (speed-inaccuracy, processing-delay, brake-feedback, traction cut-off) are defined in the OBU configuration or code and can be verified.

steps.expected: The OBU begins the calculation.

steps.action: Verify the estimated acceleration value used in the calculation.
steps.expected: The estimated acceleration is zero.

steps.action: Verify the fixed assumption values for speed-inaccuracy, processing-delay, brake-feedback, and traction cut-off.
steps.expected: The values used match the fixed assumptions specified in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction computation using EBD curve

steps.action: Verify the computed speed restriction value.

test_cases.assumptions: The trackside defines the logic as 'any one fulfilled' (OR).

steps.expected: The start condition is considered fulfilled because one sub-condition (Speed) is met.

steps.action: Reset scenario. Set train speed to 50 km/h and move train to location 1000m.
steps.expected: The start condition is considered fulfilled because one sub-condition (Location) is met.

steps.action: Move train to location 1000m while maintaining speed > 100 km/h.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a trackside text message that defines none of the start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message requesting driver confirmation, where acknowledgement is defined as 'always ending the text display'. End condition is 'Location = 5000m'.

steps.action: Display the text message. Move train to location 1000m (end condition not met).
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately, even though the end condition (Location = 5000m) is not met.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message requesting driver confirmation, where acknowledgement is defined as 'necessary condition for ending the display in addition to that end condition'. End condition is 'Location = 5000m'.

steps.action: Display the text message. Move train to location 5000m (end condition met).
steps.expected: The text display continues because driver acknowledgement has not been received.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The text display ends because both the end condition and driver acknowledgement are met.

test_cases.title: Message not displayed if end condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with start condition 'Location = 1000m' and end condition 'Location = 2000m'. Train is currently at location 2500m.

steps.action: Send the text message while the train is at location 2500m.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all, because the end condition (Location > 2000m) is already fulfilled when the start condition is evaluated.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location sub-condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with start condition 'Location = 1000m AND Speed > 50 km/h' and end condition 'Location = 1500m'.

steps.action: Set train speed to 60 km/h and move train to location 1000m.
steps.expected: The message starts displaying. The reference point for the end condition is location 1000m.

steps.action: Move train to location 1500m.
steps.expected: The message display ends, as the length of 500m from the start location (1000m) has been covered.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive LX information. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Verify the currently stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123'.

steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-B', confirming the old information was replaced.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with different identity

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data remains 'Data-A', as the new information had a different identity.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-456' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-C'.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact information).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows manual selection of RBC contact information outside Start of Mission for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the first session is still in the 'Establishing' state. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session establishment process continues or fails according to standard protocols, but no second parallel session attempt is initiated.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC (Established state)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact information or trackside order).

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the existing session is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active and no new session establishment procedure is started.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC (Start of Mission trigger)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established. The train is preparing for Start of Mission.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission command in Level 2.

steps.action: Execute Start of Mission in Level 2 while a session with RBC-A is already established.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a new communication session with RBC-A. The existing session is maintained or handled according to standard Start of Mission procedures without creating a duplicate session.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions (or the new session is with a different RBC requiring termination of the old one per standard transition).
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (e.g., RBC transition order).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to terminate existing sessions when establishing a new one with a different RBC, unless it is an Accepting RBC in a transition order where the current supervising RBC session is kept (exception case not applicable here as we assume a standard switch or single-session capability context for clarity, or simply that the new RBC is not the Accepting RBC in a transition that preserves the old session). Let's assume a standard RBC change where the old session must be terminated.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC in transition order does not terminate current supervising RBC session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established. The OBU is capable of handling multiple communication sessions through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports multiple concurrent GSM-R sessions.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an instruction to establish a session with the Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with the currently supervising RBC (RBC-A).

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Exception: Single-session capability forces termination of current RBC session for Accepting RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established. The OBU is configured to handle only one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is limited to a single GSM-R session.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an instruction to establish a session with the Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with the currently supervising RBC (RBC-A) because it can only handle one session and must establish a new one.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information validity in Sleeping mode (Nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information valid for 'Nominal' direction and information valid for 'Reverse' direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information identified as valid for the Nominal direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of information valid only for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Reverse direction.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information validity in Shunting mode (Reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information valid for 'Reverse' direction and information valid for 'Nominal' direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information identified as valid for the Reverse direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of information valid only for the Nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Nominal direction.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information valid for both directions in Passive Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Passive Shunting (PS) mode. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information identified as valid for 'Both' directions.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in PS mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information identified as valid for both directions.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on new parameter receipt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 10s). The time since the last MA request is 12 seconds (which is >= 10s).
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's MA request behavior immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: Since the time since the last MA request (12s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (5s), the OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence (no immediate request if time < new period)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 10s). The time since the last MA request is 2 seconds.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's MA request behavior immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: Since the time since the last MA request (2s) is less than the newly received repetition period (5s), the OBU does not send an MA request immediately. It waits for the next repetition interval.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. The train is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching a Danger Point which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement towards the Danger Point within the LoA.

steps.action: Move the train towards the Danger Point while the LoA is being supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the Danger Point as a Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for SvL candidates.
steps.expected: None of the SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid until Level 2 MA accepted after mode switch
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) is active. The train is moving towards a Level 2 section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2 mode. No Level 2 MA received yet.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (80 km/h) remains valid.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed limit before a Level 2 MA is accepted.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive and accept a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 MA constraints).

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction replaced by new restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 60 km/h) received from trackside.

steps.action: Receive a new Level 1 signalling related speed restriction (60 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old restriction (80 km/h) with the new one (60 km/h).

steps.action: Check the OBU's applied speed limit.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the 60 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction category
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. The train's actual performance and configuration allow a maximum speed of 200 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train configuration data indicating max speed 200 km/h.

steps.action: Configure the OBU with the train's actual maximum speed (200 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU defines the maximum train speed as 200 km/h.

steps.action: Check how the OBU handles this value in speed restriction calculations.
steps.expected: The OBU handles the 200 km/h value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state 'no speed restriction' for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. No speed restriction data has been received from trackside yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (initial state).

steps.action: Start the OBU in Level 2 mode without any trackside speed restriction data.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state for speed restrictions to ensure permitted braking distance.

steps.action: Check if any permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state 'no speed restriction' on trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A speed restriction (e.g., 100 km/h) is currently active based on trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the 'no speed restriction' state.

steps.action: Check if any permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers reconnection attempt on same system
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and has an established safe radio connection with Radio System A. EURORADIO is functional.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: Radio System A is available and capable of accepting new connections.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection between OBU and Radio System A.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active safe radio connection with Radio System A.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with Radio System A.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has lost the safe radio connection during an established communication session. The session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio environment where the first N attempts fail and the (N+1)th attempt succeeds.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session remains active and the train is before the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first reconnection attempt to fail.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the second reconnection attempt to succeed.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established and the OBU stops repeating the setup attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has lost the safe radio connection during an established communication session. The train has not passed the RIU termination location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated session termination signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination is valid and recognized by the OBU.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Trigger the termination of the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has lost the safe radio connection during an established communication session. An RIU order specifying a termination location is active. The session is not otherwise terminated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data simulating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order is correctly loaded and the location is defined.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location given in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] OBU initiates termination upon explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: The trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to the OBU. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or defined condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC). No termination conditions defined in SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside termination message. No termination condition triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1 without sending any termination message from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination when a defined termination condition is fulfilled without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 (e.g., loss of trackside link integrity or specific safety condition).
test_cases.assumptions: A specific termination condition from SUBSET-026 is simulated.

steps.action: Simulate the fulfillment of a termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 without an explicit trackside order.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats Termination message if no acknowledgement is received within fixed waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of the communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement from trackside within the fixed waiting time.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Send the 'Termination of Communication Session' message from the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Do not send an acknowledgement from the trackside within the fixed waiting time.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of the communication session and is repeating the 'Termination of Communication Session' message due to lack of acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement from trackside after the defined number of repetitions.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is specified in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Repeat the 'Termination of Communication Session' message the defined number of times without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time after the last sending.

steps.action: Do not send an acknowledgement from the trackside within the fixed waiting time after the last repetition.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi

test_cases.title: Hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi yokken varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi bulunmamaktadır (ilk güç açma veya sistem hatası sonrası). Araca yüklü GSM-R radyo sistemi mevcuttur.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Display of 'No Connection' status

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] ETC-023: Geçersiz konum iken LRBG geçişinde geçerli konumun alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir konum değeri bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG geçişinin OBU tarafından algılanması, geçerli bir konum verisinin üretilmesini tetikler.

steps.action: Trenin LRBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumu depolar.

steps.action: OBU'daki depolanan konum durumu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Konum geçerli olarak işaretlenir ve önceki geçersiz konum verisi silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: ETC-023: Geçersiz konum iken ORBG geçişinde geçerli konumun alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir konum değeri bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: ORBG geçişinin OBU tarafından algılanması, geçerli bir konum verisinin üretilmesini tetikler.

steps.action: Trenin ORBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumu depolar.

steps.action: OBU'daki depolanan konum durumu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Konum geçerli olarak işaretlenir ve önceki geçersiz konum verisi silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: ETC-023: Konum bilinmiyor iken LRBG geçişinde geçerli konumun alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediğini (unknown) raporlamaktadır. Araçta depolanan bir konum verisi yoktur veya geçersizdir.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG geçişinin OBU tarafından algılanması, geçerli bir konum verisinin üretilmesini tetikler.

steps.action: Trenin LRBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumu depolar.

steps.action: OBU'daki tren konumu durumu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Konum geçerli olarak işaretlenir.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün aktif kabin tarafına göre belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif durumu.

steps.action: OBU'dan tren yönü (orientation) sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, aktif kabinin (Kabin A) bulunduğu taraf olarak tanımlanır.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin yokken tren yönünün son aktif kabin tarafına göre belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Önce Kabin A aktifken sistem çalışmıştır. Ardından Kabin A pasife alınmış ve Kabin B de pasiftir (hiçbir kabin aktif değil).
test_cases.test_inputs: Hiçbir kabinin aktif olmadığı durum.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, son aktif kabin bilgisini bellekte tutmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'dan tren yönü (orientation) sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, son aktif kabinin (Kabin A) bulunduğu taraf olarak tanımlanır.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: Konum tabanlı denetimlerde ön uç konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren hareket halindedir ve OBU geçerli bir tren konumu hesaplamaktadır. SUBSET-026'da özel referans belirtilmeyen bir konum tabanlı fonksiyon (örneğin genel konum denetimi) aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu (estimated front end position).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu, OBU tarafından hesaplanabilir ve erişilebilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun konum tabanlı denetim fonksiyonunun kullandığı referans nokta sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Referans nokta, trenin tahmini ön uç konumu (estimated front end position) olarak belirlenmiştir.

test_cases.title: Report train position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (e.g., LRBG-100) has been passed. The OBU has reported its position to the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward. Next LRBG (LRBG-101) is passed.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-100 is compliant with SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8. Linking consistency is not checked or LRBG-100 is not marked as unlinked.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-100 and allow OBU to report position to RBC.
steps.expected: OBU reports train position to RBC referring to LRBG-100.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-101.
steps.expected: OBU updates the reference LRBG to LRBG-101 for subsequent position reports.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside information referring to recently reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported position to RBC referring to LRBG-100. LRBG-100 is within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends trackside information (e.g., movement authority) referring to LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is at least 1. LRBG-100 is the most recent reported LRBG.

steps.action: Receive trackside information from RBC referring to LRBG-100.
steps.expected: OBU accepts the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside information referring to LRBG outside recent window
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported position to RBC referring to LRBG-105. LRBG-100 is no longer within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends trackside information referring to LRBG-100.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is 3. LRBGs 103, 104, 105 are the recent ones. LRBG-100 is outside this window.

steps.action: Receive trackside information from RBC referring to LRBG-100.
steps.expected: OBU rejects the trackside information or raises an error, as LRBG-100 is not among the recently reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Compliance check with linking consistency enabled
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency check is enabled. LRBG-200 is linked and announced in linking. LRBG-200 has been passed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes LRBG-200.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-200 meets all conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 including linking consistency.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-200.
steps.expected: OBU considers LRBG-200 compliant and reports train position to RBC referring to LRBG-200.

test_cases.title: Compliance check with linking consistency disabled
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency check is disabled. LRBG-300 is not marked as unlinked. LRBG-300 has been passed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes LRBG-300.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG-300 meets all other conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8. Since linking consistency is not checked, the 'linked and announced' condition is not required.

steps.action: Pass LRBG-300.
steps.expected: OBU considers LRBG-300 compliant and reports train position to RBC referring to LRBG-300.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] OBU ignores information invalid for train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transmit a message containing data valid for 'Reverse' orientation via the selected transmission medium.
test_cases.assumptions: The transmission medium allows injection of specific orientation-tagged data for testing purposes.

steps.action: Inject a data packet tagged as valid for 'Reverse' orientation while the train orientation is 'Forward'. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the data packet; no state change or application of the data occurs.

steps.action: Inject a data packet tagged as valid for 'Forward' orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the data packet.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., orientation unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: Data packet valid for 'Forward' direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be forced into an 'orientation unknown' state for testing.

steps.action: Inject a data packet that is valid for 'Forward' direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data packet.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid in both directions when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., orientation unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: Data packet valid for both 'Forward' and 'Reverse' directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be forced into an 'orientation unknown' state for testing.

steps.action: Inject a data packet that is valid for both 'Forward' and 'Reverse' directions.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and evaluates the data packet.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile: First value applies over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving continuous profile data. Previous data state is known (e.g., default or last received).
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence: Value A (distance 100), Value B (distance 200).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the active profile value for a given distance for verification.

steps.action: Send continuous profile data with Value A for distance 100 and Value B for distance 200.
steps.expected: For distances 0 to 100, the OBU applies Value A.

steps.action: Check the active profile value at distance 150.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile: Last value applies without limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence: Value A (distance 100), Value B (distance 200). Value B is not an end-of-profile value.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the active profile value for a given distance for verification.

steps.action: Send continuous profile data with Value A for distance 100 and Value B for distance 200.
steps.expected: For distances 100 to 300, the OBU applies Value B.

steps.action: Check the active profile value at distance 500.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply Value B.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile: Value followed by zero distance is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence: Value A (distance 100), Value B (distance 0), Value C (distance 100).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the active profile value for a given distance for verification.

steps.action: Send continuous profile data with Value A for distance 100, Value B for distance 0, and Value C for distance 100.
steps.expected: Value B is registered in the profile sequence.

steps.action: Check the active profile value at distance 100.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value C (since Value B had zero length, it is effectively skipped in terms of distance coverage, but the sequence logic must handle it without error; typically the next value starts at the same distance). *Note: Depending on specific implementation of 'taken into account', this might mean it is stored but has no spatial extent. The key is that the system does not crash or ignore the subsequent data.*

test_cases.title: Location data: Distances are unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence: Value A (distance 50), Value B (distance 50).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the active location data for a given distance for verification.

steps.action: Send location data with Value A for distance 50 and Value B for distance 50.
steps.expected: For distances 0 to 50, the OBU applies Value A.

steps.action: Check the active location data at distance 75.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value B (covering distances 50 to 100).

test_cases.title: Location data: Previously received data remains in use over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received and is using Location Data X. New location data is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Sequence: Value A (distance 100).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the active location data for a given distance for verification.

steps.action: Send new location data with Value A for distance 100.
steps.expected: For distances 0 to 100, the OBU continues to use the previously received Location Data X.

steps.action: Check the active location data at distance 150.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value A.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile: Elements overlap
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Element 1: Value A, Length 100, Start Distance 0. Element 2: Value B, Length 100, Start Distance 50 (relative to previous start).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the active profile value for a given distance for verification. Overlap resolution follows SUBSET-026 (typically last received or specific priority, but the requirement states 'accept that elements overlap', implying no error).

steps.action: Send non-continuous profile data with Element 1 (Value A, Len 100, Start 0) and Element 2 (Value B, Len 100, Start 50).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data without error.

steps.action: Check the active profile value at distance 75 (where elements overlap).
steps.expected: The OBU applies one of the values (A or B) according to the defined overlap rule, without crashing or rejecting the data.

test_cases.title: Linking information: Distances to balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking Data: BG1 (Distance 100), BG2 (Distance 200).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated absolute distances to announced balise groups for verification.

steps.action: Send linking information with BG1 at distance 100 and BG2 at distance 200 (relative to BG1).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates BG1 absolute distance as 100.

steps.action: Check the calculated absolute distance for BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates BG2 absolute distance as 300 (100 + 200).

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Balise grubu konum doğruluğunun bağlantı bilgisinden alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, LRBG veya ORBG durumuna geçmeden önce geçerli bir bağlantı (linking) bilgisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı bilgisi içeren balise grubu verisi.

steps.action: OBU'ya konum doğruluğu içeren bağlantı bilgisi gönderilir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: OBU, balise grubunun konum doğruluğunu bağlantı bilgisindeki değer olarak belirler.

steps.action: Balise grubunun LRBG veya ORBG olarak işlendiği gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Kullanılan konum doğruluğu, bağlantı bilgisinden alınan değerdir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı bilgisi yoksa Ulusal Değerin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, LRBG veya ORBG durumuna geçmeden önce bağlantı bilgisi almamıştır. Ulusal Değer (National Value) tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı bilgisi içermeyen balise grubu verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Ulusal Değer 10 metre olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Bağlantı bilgisi içermeyen bir balise grubu okunur ve LRBG olarak işlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, konum doğruluğu olarak tanımlı Ulusal Değeri (10 m) kullanır.

test_cases.title: Ulusal Değer yoksa Varsayılan Değerin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, LRBG veya ORBG durumuna geçmeden önce bağlantı bilgisi almamıştır. Ulusal Değer tanımlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı bilgisi içermeyen balise grubu verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Varsayılan Değer (Default Value) 20 metre olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Bağlantı bilgisi içermeyen bir balise grubu okunur ve LRBG olarak işlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, konum doğruluğu olarak Varsayılan Değeri (20 m) kullanır.

test_cases.title: Konum doğruluğunun belirlendikten sonra güncellenmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir balise grubunun konum doğruluğunu bağlantı bilgisi üzerinden belirlemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bağlantı bilgisi veya Ulusal Değer değişikliği.
test_cases.assumptions: İlk belirlenen konum doğruluğu 5 metre olarak kabul edilir.

steps.action: Balise grubu LRBG olarak işlendikten sonra, farklı bir konum doğruluğu içeren yeni bir bağlantı bilgisi gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, konum doğruluğunu güncellemez; değer 5 metre olarak kalır.

steps.action: Bağlantı kontrolü durdurulur (linking is no longer checked).
steps.expected: OBU, konum doğruluğunu güncellemez; değer 5 metre olarak kalır.

steps.action: Yeni bir Ulusal Değer geçerli hale gelir.
steps.expected: OBU, konum doğruluğunu güncellemez; değer 5 metre olarak kalır.

test_cases.title: Tren ön ucunun güven aralığının hesaplanması (Tren uzunluğu belirsizliği yok)
test_cases.preconditions: Tren uzunluğu belirsizliğinin dahil edildiği durumlar (SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5) geçerli değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Konum doğruluğu: 10 m, Aşırı/eksik okuma miktarı: 2 m, Tahmini ön uç konumu: 100 m.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren uzunluğu belirsizliği 0 m olarak kabul edilir.

steps.action: OBU, tren ön ucunun tahmini konumunu 100 m olarak belirler.
steps.expected: OBU, min güvenli ön ucu 100 - (10 + 2) = 88 m olarak hesaplar.

steps.action: OBU, max güvenli ön ucu hesaplar.
steps.expected: OBU, max güvenli ön ucu 100 + (10 + 2) = 112 m olarak hesaplar.

test_cases.title: Tren ön ucunun güven aralığının hesaplanması (Tren uzunluğu belirsizliği dahil)
test_cases.preconditions: Tren uzunluğu belirsizliğinin dahil edildiği durumlar (SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5) geçerlidir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Konum doğruluğu: 10 m, Aşırı/eksik okuma miktarı: 2 m, Tren uzunluğu belirsizliği: 5 m, Tahmini ön uç konumu: 100 m.

steps.action: OBU, tren ön ucunun tahmini konumunu 100 m olarak belirler.
steps.expected: OBU, min güvenli ön ucu 100 - (10 + 2 + 5) = 83 m olarak hesaplar.

steps.action: OBU, max güvenli ön ucu hesaplar.
steps.expected: OBU, max güvenli ön ucu 100 + (10 + 2 + 5) = 117 m olarak hesaplar.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kontrolü aktifken SOLR seçimi
test_cases.preconditions: Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü (linking consistency check) aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı bilgisinde referans olarak gösterilen veya duyurulan en son balise grubu.

steps.action: Bağlantı bilgisinde referans olarak gösterilen bir balise grubu (BG-A) okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, BG-A'yı SOLR olarak belirler.

steps.action: Bağlantı bilgisinde duyurulan ancak henüz okunmamış bir balise grubu (BG-B) ile ilgili bilgi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, BG-B'yi SOLR olarak belirler (en son alınan bağlantı bilgisine göre).

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kontrolü pasifken SOLR seçimi
test_cases.preconditions: Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü (linking consistency check) pasiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sırayla okunan balise grupları.

steps.action: Bir balise grubu (BG-1) okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, BG-1'i SOLR olarak belirler.

steps.action: Başka bir balise grubu (BG-2) okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, BG-2'yi SOLR olarak belirler (son okunan balise grubu).

test_cases.title: Bağlantı bilgisi alınırken SOLR güncelleme kuralının uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, mevcut bir SOLR'a sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bağlantı bilgisi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m) kuralı, yeni bağlantı bilgisinin SOLR'ı değiştireceğini öngörür.

steps.action: Yeni bir bağlantı bilgisi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, SOLR'ı güncellemeden önce bağlantı değiştirme kuralını (linking replacement rule) uygular.

steps.action: SOLR güncellenir.
steps.expected: SOLR, kurala uygun olarak yeni balise grubuna atanır.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı dışı bilgi alınırken SOLR'a yeniden konumlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, mevcut bir SOLR'a sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı dışı konum tabanlı bilgi (örneğin, başka bir balise grubuna referanslı sinyal bilgisi).
test_cases.assumptions: Bilgi, SOLR'dan farklı bir balise grubuna referanslıdır.

steps.action: Bağlantı dışı bir konum tabanlı bilgi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, bilgiyi ilgili değiştirme kuralını uygulamadan önce SOLR'a yeniden konumlandırır (relocate).

steps.action: İlgili değiştirme kuralı uygulanır.
steps.expected: Bilgi, SOLR'a göre güncellenmiş konumla işlenir.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı bilginin üç konum öğesine ayrıştırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, konum tabanlı bir bilgiyi işler.
test_cases.test_inputs: Konum tabanlı bilgi (örneğin, sinyal konumu).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Table 2a, bu bilgi türü için 'estimated' konum öğesini kullanmayı gerektirir.

steps.action: OBU, konum tabanlı bilgiyi işler.
steps.expected: OBU, bilgiyi 'min', 'estimated' ve 'max' olmak üzere üç konum öğesine ayrıştırır.

steps.action: İlgili madde (clause) uygulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 Table 2a'ya göre 'estimated' konum öğesini kullanarak ilgili maddeyi uygular.

test_cases.title: Yeni SOLR'a konum öğelerinin yeniden konumlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, mevcut bir SOLR'a sahiptir ve başka bir balise grubuna referanslı konum tabanlı bilgiler mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni SOLR olarak belirlenen balise grubu.
test_cases.assumptions: Eski SOLR ile yeni SOLR arasındaki mesafe 50 m'dir.

steps.action: Yeni bir balise grubu SOLR olarak belirlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, tüm konum öğelerini yeni SOLR'a yeniden konumlandırır.

steps.action: Konum öğelerinin mesafeleri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Her konum öğesinin mesafesinden, eski referans balise grubu ile yeni SOLR arasındaki mesafe (50 m) çıkarılır.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Position report on reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed reduced to 0 km/h.

steps.action: Reduce train speed to 0 km/h to reach standstill. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active, connected to RBC, and currently at standstill (0 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed increased to > 0 km/h.

steps.action: Increase train speed from 0 km/h to a value greater than 0 km/h.
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on mode change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode change command (e.g., from Full Supervision to Shunting).

steps.action: Trigger a mode change (e.g., switch from Full Supervision to Shunting mode).
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on level change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Level change command (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1).

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., switch from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on train integrity confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active and connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Lost'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver confirms train integrity.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity via the driver machine interface.
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on train integrity loss
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active and connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Confirmed'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Integrity loss event (e.g., brake pipe pressure drop).

steps.action: Trigger a train integrity loss event (e.g., simulate brake pipe pressure drop).
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on crossing RBC/RBC border
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train crosses RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Move the train across the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active but not yet connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Session establishment with RBC.

steps.action: Establish a session with the RBC.
