test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Override mode. The train has lost valid position (e.g., after passing a balise group without reading it or due to GPS loss). The former EOA/LOA is known. The distance to be supervised is 0 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer reading, estimated/max/min safe front end positions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows simulation of 'no valid position' state and provides a diagnostic interface to observe the calculated remaining distance and the virtual train front position.

steps.action: Initiate the supervision for the zero distance to the former EOA/LOA after Override.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervising a virtual train front position.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 10 m) using the odometer.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as the supervised distance (0 m) minus the distance travelled, corrected by odometer under/over-reading. The virtual front position is updated accordingly.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current remaining distance to the former EOA/LOA.
steps.expected: The reported remaining distance reflects the movement away from the start point, adjusted for odometer errors as defined in §3.6.7.3.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance using virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The Staff Responsible maximum distance is configured (e.g., 500 m). The train is at a known location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer reading, estimated/max/min safe front end positions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the calculated remaining distance and the virtual train front position.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU begins supervising the Staff Responsible distance using a virtual train front position.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 100 m).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the virtual train front position based on the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining Staff Responsible distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated as the configured Staff Responsible distance minus the distance travelled, corrected by odometer under/over-reading as defined in §3.6.7.3.

test_cases.title: Odometer under-reading correction in virtual front position calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a distance (e.g., Staff Responsible) using a virtual train front position. The odometer is configured to simulate an under-reading (e.g., reports 90% of actual distance).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated odometer under-reading factor, actual distance travelled.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows configuration of odometer error simulation and provides a diagnostic interface to observe the corrected remaining distance.

steps.action: Start the supervision for a known distance (e.g., 100 m).
steps.expected: The OBU initializes the virtual train front position.

steps.action: Move the train by an actual distance of 50 m, but the odometer reports 45 m (10% under-reading).
steps.expected: The OBU applies the correction for odometer under-reading as defined in §3.6.7.3.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the remaining distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated using the corrected distance travelled, not the raw odometer reading, ensuring the supervision reflects the true position within the allowed error bounds.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] MA request includes all applicable reasons

steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request message.
steps.expected: The MA request message contains all the applicable MA request reasons.

steps.action: Simulate the train front approaching the location resulting from the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent while the train front has not yet passed the location.

steps.action: Simulate the train front passing the location resulting from the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion

steps.action: Simulate the passage of time until the moment resulting from the Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (Level 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. The RBC has sent a track description containing a section that is eligible for deletion under a situation defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (excluding situations a, b, f, and k).

test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen for the test is one that is not excluded (a, b, f, k) and is supported by the test environment.

steps.action: Send a track description update from the RBC that deletes a part of the track description under a valid situation (e.g., situation c).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the deletion.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's communication with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by excluded track description deletion situations
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. The RBC has sent a track description containing a section that is eligible for deletion under one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k) defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message deleting a part of the track description corresponding to an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen for the test is one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k).

steps.action: Send a track description update from the RBC that deletes a part of the track description under an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the deletion.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's communication with the RBC for a defined period.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] End Section timer start upon passing start location

test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer start location at 1000m from current position, time-out 60s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's max safe front end is accurately tracked.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting down from the received time-out value.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: The End Section timer is running. The MA includes location-based information (e.g., speed limits) and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (EOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer time-out value set to a short duration (e.g., 5s) for testing. Train speed is constant.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or wait for the timer to expire.

steps.action: Allow the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position.

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The location-based information is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the new End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can log or expose the internal MA data for verification.

steps.action: Receive MA_old from the RBC and verify it is active. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU stores and supervises MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_new from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of MA_old with the data from MA_new.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data.
steps.expected: The stored MA data matches MA_new completely, and no remnants of MA_old remain.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from a main-signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA (MA_new) read from a main-signal balise group (non-infill information) with different data than MA_old.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can distinguish between RBC messages and balise group messages.

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify it is active.
steps.expected: The OBU stores and supervises MA_old data.

steps.action: Pass a main-signal balise group containing MA_new (non-infill).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of MA_old with the data from MA_new.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data.
steps.expected: The stored MA data matches MA_new completely.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data upon receiving infill information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA (MA_old) with data up to a certain point. The next main signal is at location L_next.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA (MA_infill) containing data beyond L_next.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can identify the location of the next main signal and the infill nature of the message.

steps.action: Receive MA_old and verify it is active.
steps.expected: The OBU stores and supervises MA_old data.

steps.action: Receive MA_infill (infill information).
steps.expected: The OBU retains the data of MA_old up to the announced balise group at the next main signal (L_next) and replaces only the data beyond L_next with the data from MA_infill.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal MA data before and after L_next.
steps.expected: Data before L_next matches MA_old, and data after L_next matches MA_infill.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has an active MA. The next main signal is at a specific balise group location L_ref.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA received.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can log the start position of the new MA section.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the start position of the new MA section in the OBU.
steps.expected: The new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal (L_ref).

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA defining SvL as MA shortening while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining a Supervision Limit (SvL) where the SvL is located before the current end of the LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can log the type of MA processing (shortening vs. extension) and the deletion of location-based information.

steps.action: Receive a new MA defining an SvL while the OBU is supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 corresponding to the shortened area.

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA defining SvL as MA shortening regardless of SvL position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA defining an SvL where the SvL is located at or beyond the current end of the LOA (boundary case).
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'wherever the SvL lies', implying even if it doesn't shorten the current LOA end, it is treated as a shortening event for data management purposes.

steps.action: Receive a new MA defining an SvL located at or beyond the current LOA end.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the new MA as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Check the OBU's handling of stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 as per the shortening logic.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an active MA with a defined end of authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information packet.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the MA status to verify that no shortening action is triggered.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information while the OBU is supervising the active MA.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the repositioning information.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA status and stored authority data.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the event as an MA shortening; the stored MA data and end of authority remain unchanged.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an active MA with a defined end of authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA packet that ends with a Limit of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the MA status to verify that no shortening action is triggered.

steps.action: Receive a new MA that ends with an LOA while the OBU is supervising the previous MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's MA status and stored authority data.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat the event as an MA shortening; the MA is updated according to the new data without triggering shortening-specific deletion logic.

test_cases.title: Adoption of shortened MA when train is behind Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located behind the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list. Train position data indicating the front end is behind the new Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC request is valid and correctly formatted. The OBU can simulate or receive a specific train position relative to the MA limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a value where the Indication supervision limit is ahead of the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU has adopted the proposed shortened MA, the associated mode profile, and the SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to adopt the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Rejection of shortened MA when train is at or ahead of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located at or ahead of the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value where the Indication supervision limit is behind or at the current train front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC request is valid and correctly formatted. The OBU can simulate or receive a specific train position relative to the MA limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a value where the Indication supervision limit is behind the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value where the Indication supervision limit coincides exactly with the current train front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear of' for adoption. Therefore, being exactly at the limit is not 'in rear of', so it should be rejected. This test verifies the boundary interpretation.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a value where the Indication supervision limit is exactly at the current train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request, as the train is not in rear of the limit.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, desteklenen infill ortamları listesine sahip olarak yapılandırılmıştır. OBU, geçerli bir balis grubundan önceki seyrine ait güncel bilgiyi almıştır.

test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun desteklemediği bir infill ortamı (örneğin, OBU'da bulunmayan bir radyo frekansı veya protokol) test senaryosunda tanımlanmıştır.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill

steps.expected: OBU processes and accepts the infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit further infill information from the loop antenna.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the received infill information (no state change or processing log entry for the infill).

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the processing status of infill data and the detection of the missed balise.

steps.action: Transmit valid infill information from the loop antenna.
steps.expected: OBU processes and accepts the infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the condition where the OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: OBU registers the detection of the missed main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit further infill information from the loop antenna.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the received infill information (no state change or processing log entry for the infill).

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Permitted braking distance data receipt triggers speed restriction computation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to trackside. Trackside is configured to send valid permitted braking distance data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid permitted braking distance data packet from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of logging or exposing the computed speed restriction value for verification.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions: Fixed assumptions for delays and inaccuracies

test_cases.preconditions: OBU, henüz geçmediği bir Mode Profile başlangıcına sahiptir. Bu Mode Profile SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da LOA vardır ve LOA, Mode Profile başlangıcının gerisindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: SvL gerektirmeyen Mode Profile, LOA başlangıcın gerisinde olan MA.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 kuralları geçerlidir.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına yaklaşırken hareket izleme durumu incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici EOA olarak ele alır.

steps.action: Geçici SvL'nin konumu ve hız profili incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, LOA geride olduğu için (LOA in rear of it) geçici SvL'yi Mode Profile başlangıcında uygular ve serbest bırakma hızı içermez.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive LX information. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Verify the currently stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123'.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-A'.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-B', confirming the old information was replaced.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with different identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-456' and Data 'Data-C'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-456' and Data 'Data-C' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data remains 'Data-A', as the new information had a different identity.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-456' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-C'.

test_cases.title: Phishing-resistant authentication option availability at AAL2
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to support at least one phishing-resistant method (e.g., FIDO2/WebAuthn) as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.5.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page for the company representative portal.
steps.expected: The login interface displays at least one authentication option that is phishing-resistant (e.g., 'Use Security Key' or 'Passkey').

steps.action: Select the phishing-resistant authentication option and complete the authentication process.
steps.expected: The system successfully authenticates the user and grants access to the portal, confirming the option is functional.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with multi-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is configured for AAL2 authentication using a multi-factor authenticator (e.g., TOTP).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, valid TOTP code.
test_cases.assumptions: The multi-factor authenticator is synchronized with the server time.

steps.action: Enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the second factor (multi-factor authenticator code).

steps.action: Enter the valid TOTP code from the authenticator app.
steps.expected: The system authenticates the user successfully and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with two separate factors (Password + SMS)
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is configured for AAL2 authentication using two separate factors: password and SMS OTP.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, valid SMS OTP.
test_cases.assumptions: The registered mobile number is active and can receive SMS.

steps.action: Enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system sends an SMS OTP to the registered mobile number and prompts for the code.

steps.action: Enter the valid SMS OTP code.
steps.expected: The system authenticates the user successfully and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with invalid second factor
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is configured for AAL2 authentication using a multi-factor authenticator.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, valid password, invalid TOTP code.

steps.action: Enter the valid username and password.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the second factor.

steps.action: Enter an invalid TOTP code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating the second factor is invalid.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with invalid first factor
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password.

steps.action: Enter the valid username and an invalid password.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating invalid credentials. The second factor prompt is not shown.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun inaktivite zaman aşımında yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak kabul edilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli AAL2 oturum kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra 15 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmadan bekler.
steps.expected: Sistem, inaktivite zaman aşımının dolmasıyla birlikte kullanıcıyı yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılayan kimlik bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı başarıyla tamamlar ve kullanıcının oturumunu devam ettirir.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun genel zaman aşımında yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan genel zaman aşımı süresi 8 saat olarak kabul edilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli AAL2 oturum kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te genel zaman aşımı süresi 8 saat olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra 8 saat boyunca periyodik olarak (inaktivite zaman aşımını tetiklemeyecek şekilde) işlem yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, genel zaman aşımının dolmasıyla birlikte kullanıcıyı yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılayan kimlik bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı başarıyla tamamlar ve kullanıcının oturumunu devam ettirir.

test_cases.title: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama başarısız olduğunda oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi dolmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz veya eksik AAL2 kimlik bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, inaktivite zaman aşımı dolunca gelen yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında geçersiz kimlik bilgileri girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı reddeder ve hata mesajı gösterir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturumun devam edip etmediğini kontrol eder.
steps.expected: Sistem, oturumu sonlandırır ve kullanıcıyı ana giriş ekranına yönlendirir.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to representative upon account recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is in a recoverable state. The representative's contact details are valid and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification channel (e.g., email) is monitored and accessible for verification.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The system successfully processes the recovery request.

steps.action: Check the notification channel associated with the representative's account.
steps.expected: A notification regarding the account recovery is received by the representative.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to designee upon account recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A designee has been previously specified for this account. The designee's contact details are valid and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The designee specification is correctly stored in the system. The notification channel for the designee is monitored.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The system successfully processes the recovery request.

steps.action: Check the notification channel associated with the designee's contact details.
steps.expected: A notification regarding the account recovery is received by the designee.

test_cases.title: Electronic notification addresses receive account notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with at least one valid email address and one valid phone number registered as notification addresses.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account ID: COMP-REP-001, Notification Event: Account Created
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows interception or verification of outgoing email and SMS messages.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event (e.g., account creation) for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system initiates sending notifications to all registered electronic notification addresses.

steps.action: Check the inbox of the registered email address.
steps.expected: An account notification email is received.

steps.action: Check the SMS log or device for the registered phone number.
steps.expected: An account notification SMS is received.

test_cases.title: Postal addresses are excluded from account notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a postal address registered as a notification address, along with at least one electronic notification address (email).
test_cases.test_inputs: Account ID: COMP-REP-002, Notification Event: Password Reset Requested
test_cases.assumptions: The system logs all attempted notification deliveries, including those to postal addresses if any logic exists, or simply does not generate postal mail tasks.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event (e.g., password reset request) for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system processes the notification request.

steps.action: Verify that no physical mail or postal notification task is generated for the registered postal address.
steps.expected: No postal notification is sent or queued for the postal address.

steps.action: Verify that the electronic notification address receives the notification.
steps.expected: The email notification is sent successfully.

test_cases.title: Notifications sent to all registered electronic addresses
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with multiple distinct electronic notification addresses (e.g., two different email addresses and one phone number).
test_cases.test_inputs: Account ID: COMP-REP-003, Notification Event: Security Alert

steps.action: Trigger a security alert notification for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system identifies all registered electronic notification addresses.

steps.action: Check the first registered email address.
steps.expected: The security alert email is received.

steps.action: Check the second registered email address.
steps.expected: The security alert email is received.

steps.action: Check the registered phone number.
steps.expected: The security alert SMS is received.

test_cases.title: e-Devlet assertion süresi dolmadan VBP oturumunun devam etmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcının geçerli bir e-Devlet oturumu vardır ve VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli e-Devlet assertion'ı.
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet assertion'ının geçerlilik süresi 5 dakikadır ve VBP oturum süresi bu süreden uzundur.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP'ye e-Devlet üzerinden giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı VBP oturumuna başarıyla girer.

steps.action: e-Devlet assertion'ının geçerlilik süresi dolana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: VBP oturumu devam eder, kullanıcı oturumdan atılmaz.

steps.action: VBP'de bir işlem yapılır (örneğin, başvuru formu doldurulur).
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır, oturum kesintiye uğramaz.

test_cases.title: e-Devlet assertion süresi dolduktan sonra VBP oturumunun devam etmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcının VBP oturumu aktiftir ve e-Devlet assertion'ının geçerlilik süresi dolmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli e-Devlet assertion'ı (süresi dolmuş).
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet assertion'ının geçerlilik süresi 5 dakikadır.

steps.action: e-Devlet assertion'ının geçerlilik süresi dolduğundan emin olunur.
steps.expected: e-Devlet assertion'ı artık geçerli değildir.

steps.action: VBP'de bir işlem yapılır (örneğin, başvuru durumu sorgulanır).
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır, VBP oturumu devam eder.

steps.action: VBP oturumunun aktif olduğu doğrulanır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı hâlâ VBP oturumundadır, oturum sonlandırılmamıştır.

test_cases.title: Federation transaction initiation includes VBP identifier and nonce
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a valid identifier for e-Devlet federation. A valid user session is established in VBP.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials for VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: Network traffic between VBP and e-Devlet can be intercepted and inspected for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate a federation transaction from VBP to e-Devlet.
steps.expected: VBP sends an assertion request to e-Devlet.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a field identifying VBP.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a cryptographic nonce value.

test_cases.title: Assertion request nonce is unique per transaction
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured for federation with e-Devlet.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials for VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: Multiple federation transactions can be initiated in succession.

steps.action: Initiate the first federation transaction and capture the nonce value from the assertion request.
steps.expected: A nonce value N1 is present in the request.

steps.action: Initiate a second federation transaction and capture the nonce value from the assertion request.
steps.expected: A nonce value N2 is present in the request.

steps.action: Compare N1 and N2.
steps.expected: N1 is not equal to N2.

test_cases.title: VBP audience identifier'ı içeren e-Devlet assertion'ının kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet SSO ile entegre edilmiş ve test ortamında çalışmaktadır. VBP'nin e-Devlet'te kayıtlı Audience ID'si (ör. 'vbp-test-aud') bilinmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Audience alanı 'vbp-test-aud' değerini içeren geçerli bir e-Devlet SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: Assertion'ın imzası ve geçerlilik süresi kontrolünden bağımsız olarak, bu test yalnızca audience kontrolüne odaklanmaktadır.

steps.action: Audience alanı VBP'nin Audience ID'sini ('vbp-test-aud') içeren bir e-Devlet assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı kabul eder ve kullanıcı oturumu başlatılır.

test_cases.title: VBP audience identifier'ı içermeyen e-Devlet assertion'ının reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet SSO ile entegre edilmiş ve test ortamında çalışmaktadır. VBP'nin e-Devlet'te kayıtlı Audience ID'si (ör. 'vbp-test-aud') bilinmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Audience alanı başka bir RP'nin ID'sini (ör. 'other-rp-aud') içeren, VBP'nin ID'sini içermeyen geçerli bir e-Devlet SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: Assertion'ın imzası ve geçerlilik süresi kontrolünden bağımsız olarak, bu test yalnızca audience kontrolüne odaklanmaktadır.

steps.action: Audience alanı VBP'nin Audience ID'sini içermeyen, başka bir RP'ye ait bir e-Devlet assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı reddeder ve oturum başlatılmaz. Hata mesajı veya yönlendirme, assertion'ın geçersiz olduğunu belirtir.

test_cases.title: Audience alanının boş olduğu e-Devlet assertion'ının reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet SSO ile entegre edilmiş ve test ortamında çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Audience alanı boş veya hiç bulunmayan geçerli bir e-Devlet SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: Assertion'ın imzası ve geçerlilik süresi kontrolünden bağımsız olarak, bu test yalnızca audience kontrolüne odaklanmaktadır.

steps.action: Audience alanı boş veya tanımsız olan bir e-Devlet assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı reddeder ve oturum başlatılmaz.

test_cases.title: Company representative changes pre-registered phone number via binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated and has access to the profile settings.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number, SMS code sent to the new number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2 binding process as described in §3.1.3.3, which includes sending a verification code to the new number.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process, prompting for the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter a new valid telephone number and submit the request.
steps.expected: The system sends an SMS verification code to the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter the received SMS verification code into the system.
steps.expected: The system validates the code and successfully binds the new telephone number as the authenticator.

steps.action: Check the profile settings for the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The new telephone number is displayed as the current pre-registered number.

test_cases.title: Company representative attempts to change phone number without completing binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number, incorrect or missing SMS code.
test_cases.assumptions: The binding process requires successful verification via SMS code to complete.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process, prompting for the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter a new valid telephone number and submit the request.
steps.expected: The system sends an SMS verification code to the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter an incorrect SMS verification code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and does not update the pre-registered telephone number.

steps.action: Check the profile settings for the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The original pre-registered telephone number remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Company representative attempts to bypass binding process by direct API call or UI manipulation
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number, attempt to skip SMS verification step.
test_cases.assumptions: The system enforces the binding process strictly, preventing any direct modification of the phone number without completing the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2 flow.

steps.action: Attempt to modify the pre-registered telephone number by directly calling the backend API endpoint without completing the SMS verification step.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request and returns an error indicating that the binding process must be completed.

steps.action: Check the profile settings for the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The original pre-registered telephone number remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Binding a second authenticator to an account with one existing authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a new authenticator (e.g., new phone number or security key).
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports at least two authenticators per account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using the existing authenticator.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the account settings page.

steps.action: Navigate to the security settings and select the option to add a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the interface for binding a new authenticator.

steps.action: Enter the details for the new authenticator and complete the verification process.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the new authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators in the security settings.
steps.expected: Both the original and the newly added authenticator are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Binding a third authenticator to an account with two existing authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two active authenticators bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a third new authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows more than two authenticators per account.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using one of the existing authenticators.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Navigate to the security settings and select the option to add a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the interface for binding a new authenticator.

steps.action: Enter the details for the third authenticator and complete the verification process.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the third authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators in the security settings.
steps.expected: All three authenticators are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when account max is lower than authenticator max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New authenticator with max AAL 3
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows binding a new authenticator to an existing account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator (max AAL 3) to the account (max AAL 2).
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication at AAL 2.

steps.action: Provide valid authentication credentials for AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted and the new authenticator is bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when authenticator max is lower than account max

test_cases.title: Geçerli e-Devlet imzasının doğrulanması

test_cases.test_inputs: e-Devlet'in özel anahtarıyla imzalanmış, geçerli bir SAML Assertion paketi.

steps.action: Doğrulama sonucunun sistem loglarında veya durum değişkenlerinde kaydedildiği kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Loglarda 'Signature Validated' veya eşdeğer başarılı doğrulama kaydı bulunur.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz imza ile assertion'ın reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem, e-Devlet'in doğrulama anahtarını yapılandırılmış olarak barındırmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Farklı bir anahtar çiftiyle imzalanmış veya bozulmuş bir SAML Assertion paketi.
test_cases.assumptions: Test için e-Devlet'e ait olmayan bir özel anahtar kullanılarak imzalanmış bir assertion üretilmiştir.

steps.action: e-Devlet'in doğrulama anahtarıyla eşleşmeyen bir imzaya sahip assertion paketi VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem assertion'ı reddeder ve doğrulama hatası (signature validation failed) üretir.

steps.action: Oturum açma işleminin devam edip etmediği kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Oturum açma işlemi başarısız olur ve kullanıcı hata mesajı alır.

test_cases.title: Doğru IdP için yanlış anahtarın kullanılması

test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, IdP kimliğine göre doğru doğrulama anahtarını seçmek üzere yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.expected: Sistem, e-Devlet'e ait doğrulama anahtarını kullanarak imzayı doğrulamaya çalışır ve başarısız olur.

steps.action: Doğrulama sonucunun hata olarak raporlandığı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sistem 'Invalid Signature' veya 'IdP Mismatch' hatası verir ve oturumu açmaz.

test_cases.title: İlk e-Devlet assertion'ının kabul edilmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli ve daha önce kullanılmamış bir e-Devlet assertion.

steps.action: VBP'ye ilk kez geçerli bir e-Devlet assertion'ı iletilir.
steps.expected: Sistem assertion'ı kabul eder ve kullanıcı oturumunu başlatır.

steps.expected: Sistem assertion'ı reddeder ve replay saldırısı veya geçersiz oturum hatası verir.

test_cases.title: VBP'nin e-Devlet ile federasyon işleminde RP olarak başlatması
test_cases.preconditions: VBP ve e-Devlet sistemleri aktif ve birbirine bağlıdır. Test kullanıcısı VBP'de kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli VBP kullanıcı kimlik bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem logları veya ağ yakalama aracı ile kimlik doğrulama isteğinin (Authn Request) kaynağı gözlemlenebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP portalında e-Devlet ile giriş seçeneğini seçer.

steps.action: Verify the user's assurance level in the system database.

test_cases.title: Validation of digitally signed attributes on SUPERIOR evidence

test_cases.title: Rejection when core attributes are missing in authoritative source comparison

test_cases.title: SMS code generation does not reset failed authentication count
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a failed authentication count greater than 0 (e.g., 2 failed attempts).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid phone number associated with the account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows generating a new SMS code even when the failed authentication count is non-zero.

steps.action: Log in with the company representative account using an incorrect password twice to establish a failed authentication count of 2.
steps.expected: The system records 2 failed authentication attempts for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the account.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent to the registered phone number.

steps.action: Check the failed authentication count of the account in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 2 and has not been reset to 0.

test_cases.title: SMS code generation does not reset failed authentication count at threshold boundary
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a failed authentication count equal to the maximum allowed before lockout (e.g., 4 out of 5).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials, valid phone number associated with the account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system lockout threshold is 5 failed attempts. The account is currently at 4 failed attempts.

steps.action: Log in with the company representative account using an incorrect password 4 times to establish a failed authentication count of 4.
steps.expected: The system records 4 failed authentication attempts for the account.

steps.action: Initiate the process to generate a new SMS one-time code for the account.
steps.expected: A new SMS one-time code is generated and sent to the registered phone number.

steps.action: Check the failed authentication count of the account in the system logs or database.
steps.expected: The failed authentication count remains 4 and has not been reset to 0.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password one more time (5th attempt).
steps.expected: The account is locked due to reaching the maximum failed authentication count of 5.

test_cases.title: Multiple authenticator failure threshold triggers disablement
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor (e.g., TOTP) enabled. The account is not currently disabled. The failure threshold defined in VBP SDD §14 is known (assumed to be 5 for this test).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, invalid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold for consecutive failed attempts is 5. The system tracks failures per authenticator type and per account.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. Password failure count increments to 1.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid username, valid password, and invalid second-factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. Second-factor failure count increments to 1.

steps.action: Repeat the sequence of invalid password and invalid second-factor attempts until the total consecutive failed authentication attempts on the account reach the threshold (5 attempts total, involving both authenticators).
steps.expected: The 5th failed attempt is recorded. The system detects that the threshold has been reached and that more than one authenticator was involved in the consecutive failures.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator is disabled.

test_cases.title: Single authenticator failure does not disable other authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor enabled. The account is not currently disabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, valid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold is 5. The requirement specifies disabling only if *more than one* authenticator is involved in the consecutive failures.

steps.action: Attempt login 5 times with valid username, invalid password, and valid second-factor code.
steps.expected: All 5 attempts fail. Only the password authenticator is involved in the failures.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled (due to reaching threshold for that specific authenticator, per standard lockout policies, though KDH-038 specifically addresses the multi-authenticator case. However, to strictly test KDH-038's condition 'more than one authenticator involved', we verify that the *second factor* is NOT disabled by this specific rule).

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator remains enabled, as it was not involved in the failed attempts.

test_cases.title: Failures below threshold do not disable authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with password and second-factor enabled. The account is not currently disabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, invalid password, invalid second-factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The failure threshold is 5.

steps.action: Attempt login 4 times with valid username, invalid password, and invalid second-factor code.
steps.expected: All 4 attempts fail. Both authenticators are involved in the failures.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator remains enabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second-factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The second-factor authenticator remains enabled.

steps.action: Attempt to use the re-bound authenticator for authentication.

test_cases.title: Re-binding required before use after threshold reached

test_cases.title: Session AAL must not exceed authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL1 and AAL2. The system allows session creation via authentication events.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL1 authentication. A request to establish a session with AAL2 context.
test_cases.assumptions: The system exposes a mechanism or API parameter to request a specific AAL level for the session, or the session context is derived from the authentication method used. For this test, we assume an attempt to force or simulate a higher AAL session context after a lower AAL authentication.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using a method that establishes an AAL1 authentication event (e.g., password only).
steps.expected: The authentication event is recorded as AAL1. A session is created.

steps.action: Attempt to access a resource or perform an action that requires or implies an AAL2 session context, or explicitly request the session to be treated as AAL2.
steps.expected: The system rejects the request or denies access. The session is not treated as AAL2. The system may prompt for re-authentication at AAL2 or return an error indicating insufficient assurance level.

test_cases.title: Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL2. The system allows session creation via authentication events.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL2 authentication (e.g., password + OTP). A request to establish a session with AAL1 context.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows a session to be established with a lower AAL than the authentication event, as permitted by NIST SP 800-63B-4 §5.1. This is typically used for less sensitive operations or when the user explicitly chooses a lower assurance level for the session.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using a method that establishes an AAL2 authentication event (e.g., password + OTP).
steps.expected: The authentication event is recorded as AAL2. A session is created.

steps.action: Access a resource or perform an action that requires only AAL1, or explicitly request the session to be treated as AAL1.
steps.expected: The system allows the access. The session is treated as AAL1 for this context. No error is raised.

test_cases.title: Failed sign-in response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists in the system. A non-existing user identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user ID, invalid password. Non-existing user ID, invalid password.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows sign-in attempts with both valid and invalid credentials.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a valid user ID and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') and a specific HTTP status code (e.g., 401 or 200 with error body).

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a non-existing user ID and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1.

steps.action: Measure the response time for the sign-in attempt with the valid user ID.
steps.expected: The response time is within the same statistical range as the response time for the non-existing user ID, with no significant delay indicating user existence.

test_cases.title: Failed registration response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists in the system. A non-existing user identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Registration form with existing user ID. Registration form with non-existing user ID.
test_cases.assumptions: The registration process validates user uniqueness.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a user ID that already exists in the system.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Registration failed') and a specific HTTP status code.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a user ID that does not exist in the system.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1, or a success message that does not reveal the previous state of the ID if the ID was previously used and deleted, but typically for uniqueness checks, the error should be generic to prevent enumeration. *Correction*: If the ID is new, registration might succeed. To test enumeration, we compare the *failure* case of an existing ID against a *failure* case of an invalid format or similar, OR we assume the requirement implies that the *response* to a failed attempt (e.g., duplicate) should not differ from a failed attempt due to other reasons in a way that reveals existence. However, standard OWASP V6.3.8 focuses on sign-in. For registration, if the ID exists, it fails. If it doesn't, it succeeds. This inherently reveals existence. The requirement says 'prevent valid users from being deduced from... registration... responses'. This usually means the error message for 'user exists' should be generic or the system should not distinguish between 'user exists' and 'invalid input' in a way that allows enumeration if the input is invalid. Let's assume the test is about the *error* response when registration fails due to existing user vs other validation errors, or that the system does not explicitly state 'User already exists' but says 'Registration unsuccessful'. Let's refine: The test should verify that the error message for an existing user is not distinctively different from other registration errors in a way that allows easy enumeration, or that the response time is consistent. Given the strictness, let's focus on the error message content.

steps.action: Compare the error message content and HTTP status code from step 1 with a registration failure due to a different validation error (e.g., invalid email format).
steps.expected: The error messages are generic enough that they do not explicitly confirm the existence of the user ID, or the system uses a uniform 'Registration failed' message for all server-side validation failures related to user identity.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Görsel içeriklerde metin alternatifi kontrolü

steps.action: Ana sayfadaki bilgilendirici görsellerin HTML kodu incelenir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: Her bir bilgilendirici görselin 'alt' özniteliği dolu ve içeriği açıklayıcıdır.

test_cases.title: Tablo ve liste yapısının programatik erişilebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Tablo ve liste içeren bir sayfa (örneğin başvuru durumu listesi) yüklü.

steps.action: Sayfadaki tabloların HTML kodu incelenir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki listelerin HTML kodu incelenir.
steps.expected: Listeler 'ul' veya 'ol' ve 'li' etiketleri kullanılarak yapılandırılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Ekran yönü bağımsızlığı testi

steps.expected: İçerik yatay konumda da okunabilir, düğmeler tıklanabilir ve form alanları erişilebilir durumdadır; içerik kaybı yaşanmaz.

test_cases.title: Form alanı amaçlarının programatik belirlenmesi

steps.expected: Her bir alanın 'autocomplete' özniteliği, WCAG'deki girdi amaçlarına uygun değerler (örneğin 'name', 'email', 'tel', 'street-address') içermektedir.

test_cases.title: Metin kontrast oranı kontrolü

steps.action: Sayfadaki standart boyutlu metinlerin (14pt veya 18.66px altı) arka plan ve metin renkleri ölçülür.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan kontrast oranı en az 4.5:1'dir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki büyük boyutlu metinlerin (18pt veya 24pt altı, 14pt bold veya 18.66px bold) arka plan ve metin renkleri ölçülür.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan kontrast oranı en az 3:1'dir.

steps.expected: İçerik kaybı yaşanmaz, düğmeler ve form alanları hâlâ erişilebilir ve kullanılabilir durumdadır.

test_cases.title: Metin boşlukları ayarları testi

steps.expected: Dosya yükleme alanına klavyeyle erişilebilir, dosya seçme işlemi klavyeyle başlatılabilir.

test_cases.title: Klavye odak göstergesi kontrolü

test_cases.preconditions: İngilizce arayüzde Türkçe resmî belge adları içeren bir sayfa yüklü.

steps.action: Sayfadaki Türkçe resmî belge adlarının HTML kodu incelenir.
steps.expected: Türkçe metinler, 'lang' özniteliği 'tr' veya 'tr-TR' olan bir öğe (örneğin '<span lang=

test_cases.title: UI bileşenlerinin ad, rol ve durum bildirimlerinin programatik kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın bir başvuru formu sayfası yüklü ve ekran okuyucu veya geliştirici araçları erişilebilir durumda.
test_cases.assumptions: HTML kaynağı ve DOM ağacı tarayıcı geliştirici araçları veya ekran okuyucu eklentisi ile incelenebilir.

steps.action: Formdaki bir metin giriş alanının (örneğin 'Ad' alanı) DOM elemanı incelenir.
steps.expected: Elemanın 'role' özelliği 'textbox' olarak belirlenmiştir ve 'aria-label' veya ilişkili 'label' ile adı 'Ad' olarak programatik olarak okunabilir.

steps.action: Formdaki bir onay kutusunun (checkbox) DOM elemanı incelenir.
steps.expected: Elemanın 'role' özelliği 'checkbox' olarak belirlenmiştir ve 'aria-checked' özelliği mevcut durumunu (true/false) yansıtmaktadır.

steps.action: Onay kutusunun durumu klavye veya fare ile değiştirilir.
steps.expected: DOM elemanındaki 'aria-checked' değeri anında güncellenir ve bu değişiklik ekran okuyucu tarafından 'seçildi' veya 'seçilmedi' olarak duyurulur.

steps.action: Bir açılır menü (select) elemanının DOM yapısı incelenir.
steps.expected: Elemanın 'role' özelliği 'combobox' veya 'listbox' olarak belirlenmiştir ve seçili değerin adı programatik olarak erişilebilir durumdadır.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Ortak hesap kullanımının engellenmesi ve kullanıcı tanımlarının tek kişiye ataması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde yönetici yetkisine sahip bir test hesabı ve iki farklı test kullanıcısı (Kullanıcı A ve Kullanıcı B) tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kullanıcı A ve Kullanıcı B'nin kimlik bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: Kullanıcı A ve B'nin sistemdeki tanımlarının tek bir kişiye ait olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı A ile sisteme giriş yapılır ve bir işlem (örneğin başvuru oluşturma) gerçekleştirilir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır ve işlem günlüğünde (log) işlemi yapan kişi olarak 'Kullanıcı A' bilgisi kaydedilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı B ile sisteme giriş yapılır ve aynı türde bir işlem gerçekleştirilir.
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır ve işlem günlüğünde işlemi yapan kişi olarak 'Kullanıcı B' bilgisi kaydedilir.

steps.action: İşlem günlükleri incelenerek her bir işlemin tek bir kullanıcıya atandığı doğrulanır.
steps.expected: Hiçbir işlemin 'Ortak Hesap' veya benzeri genel bir tanımla kaydedilmediği, her işlemin spesifik bir kullanıcıya atandığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Varsayılan ve tahmin edilebilir kimlik bilgileriyle giriş denemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem kurulumu tamamlanmış ve varsayılan hesapların kaldırıldığı veya parolalarının değiştirildiği varsayılmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yaygın varsayılan kullanıcı adı/parola kombinasyonları (örn: admin/admin, root/root, test/test).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistemde varsayılan hesaplar aktif olarak kullanılamaz hale getirilmiştir.

steps.action: Oturum açma ekranında yaygın bir varsayılan kullanıcı adı (örn: 'admin') ve varsayılan parola (örn: 'admin') girilerek giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir ve 'Kullanıcı adı veya parola hatalı' benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterilir.

steps.action: Diğer yaygın varsayılan kombinasyonlarla (örn: 'root'/'root') giriş denemeleri yapılır.
steps.expected: Tüm denemeler reddedilir ve sistemde bu kimlik bilgileriyle erişim sağlanamaz.

test_cases.title: Kaba kuvvet saldırısına karşı istek sınırlandırma ve yanıt tutarlılığı
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde istek sınırlandırma (rate limiting) mekanizması aktif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli olmayan bir kullanıcı adı ve parola kombinasyonu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, belirli bir süre içinde belirli sayıda başarısız denemeden sonra istekleri kısıtlamaktadır.

steps.action: Aynı geçersiz kullanıcı adı ve parola kombinasyonuyla kısa bir süre içinde ardışık olarak 10 kez giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Belirli bir deneme sayısından sonra (sistem politikasına göre) sistem, 'Çok fazla deneme yapıldı, lütfen daha sonra tekrar deneyin' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterir ve sonraki denemeleri reddeder.

steps.action: Başarılı ve başarısız giriş denemelerinin HTTP yanıt boyutları karşılaştırılır.
steps.expected: Başarılı ve başarısız giriş denemelerinin yanıt boyutları (byte cinsinden) aynı veya istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir fark göstermeyecek kadar yakındır; kimlik doğrulama sonucunun yanıt boyutundan anlaşılamadığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Hassas işlem öncesi yeniden kimlik doğrulama zorunluluğu
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı sisteme giriş yapmış ve oturum aktiftir. Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §5.4'te 'Hassas İşlem' olarak tanımlanan bir fonksiyon (örn: Kişisel verileri değiştirme) mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hassas işlemi tetikleyen form verileri.
test_cases.assumptions: Hassas işlem, mevcut oturumda ek bir kimlik doğrulama gerektirmektedir.

steps.action: Aktif oturumda, hassas olarak tanımlanan bir işlemi (örn: telefon numarasını değiştirme) başlatmak için ilgili butona tıklanır.
steps.expected: Sistem, işlemi tamamlamadan önce kullanıcıdan yeniden kimlik doğrulaması (örn: parola veya SMS kodu) ister.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında doğru kimlik bilgileri girilir.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve hassas işlem tamamlanabilir hale gelir.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında yanlış kimlik bilgileri girilir.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarısız olur ve hassas işlem tamamlanamaz; kullanıcı hata mesajı alır.

test_cases.title: Vatandaş kimlik doğrulamasında e-Devlet entegrasyonunun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde e-Devlet entegrasyonu aktif ve test ortamında e-Devlet test altyapısına erişim sağlanabilir durumda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli e-Devlet kullanıcı adı ve parolası.
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet test ortamı, portalın kimlik doğrulama isteklerini doğru şekilde yanıtlayabilmektedir.

steps.action: Vatandaş portalına giriş ekranında 'e-Devlet ile Giriş' seçeneği seçilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, e-Devlet kimlik doğrulama sayfasına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: e-Devlet sayfasında geçerli kullanıcı adı ve parolası girilerek doğrulama tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, portalın ana sayfasına başarıyla yönlendirilir ve oturum açılmış olarak görünür.

steps.action: Portalın kimlik doğrulama logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama işleminin e-Devlet sistemi üzerinden gerçekleştirildiği ve portalın yerel kullanıcı veritabanı sorgulanmadığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Personel kimlik doğrulamasında KKS entegrasyonunun kullanılması

steps.expected: Kullanıcı, KKS kimlik doğrulama sayfasına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: KKS sayfasında geçerli kullanıcı adı ve parolası girilerek doğrulama tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, portalın ana sayfasına başarıyla yönlendirilir ve oturum açılmış olarak görünür.

steps.action: Portalın kimlik doğrulama logları incelenir.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama işleminin KKS sistemi üzerinden gerçekleştirildiği ve portalın yerel kullanıcı veritabanı sorgulanmadığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Kimlik doğrulama sonrası yeni oturum kimliğinin üretilmesi

steps.expected: Oturum kimliği A geçerli bir değerdir.

steps.expected: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur.

steps.expected: Yeni bir oturum kimliği üretilmiştir ve Session ID - B, Session ID - A'dan farklıdır.

test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aktif bir oturum içindedir.

test_cases.title: Oturum kapatma işlevinin mevcut olması ve çalışması

steps.expected: Parola değiştirme formu görüntülenir.

steps.expected: Parola değişikliği başarılı olarak bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Belirli süre etkinlik olmamasında oturumun geçersiz kılınması

test_cases.title: Seçilen etkin oturumun sonlandırılması

test_cases.title: Kişisel veriye erişimde denetim kaydı oluşturulması

test_cases.title: Kritik kaynağa erişimde denetim kaydı oluşturulması
